launches.title: Leeroo - Trainable AI Agents
launches.tagline: Trainable AI agents that keep learning—and getting better at their job—every day
launches.body:
Hi everyone 👋

Leeroo delivers **trainable AI agents that learn much like human colleagues— from knowledge bases, human feedback, and even their own past experiences.** That continuous learning bridges the gap between generic AI and the expert performance companies need. We’re starting with agents for **data- and AI-teams**.

[https://youtu.be/ONHTKTB7Dik](https://youtu.be/ONHTKTB7Dik?feature=shared)

### **❌** Problem

AI agents look impressive, but for specialized work they remain semi-experts—and you can’t effectively train them into experts. General-purpose agents can’t learn from their own experience, human guidance, or domain-specific materials, so they quickly plateau at basic capabilities. Data and AI tasks demand deep specialization that off-the-shelf agents simply don’t reach.

### **✅** Our Solution

Scaling pre-training to squeeze out marginally better foundation models has flat-lined. **The real moat isn’t building demo agents, it’s training that agent to expert level on your private context.** While agent scaffolding is commoditising fast, Leeroo’s on-prem, **continuous-learning engine transforms your data, workflows, and tacit know-how into a compounding strategic asset—without leaving your VPC.**

**What Makes Leeroo different**

* **Continuous Learning Loop:** Every interaction becomes training data. Agents digest codebases, docs, videos, self-discovery experiences, and your real-time feedback, then consolidate the lot overnight—so yesterday’s lessons fuel tomorrow’s results.
* **Domain-Specific Reasoning Library:** Symbolic search, specialised code synthesis, and deep data/ML expertise tackle real engineering problems directly, not through brute-force guessing.
* **Multi-Agent Workforce:** Multiple agents collaborating asynchronously on heavy jobs, could run entirely inside your VPC.

Our early **customers** already **see their trained agents as high-value assets—assets that appreciate as the agents keep mastering more of the organisation’s knowledge.**

### Team

We’ve worked together for 3 + years on various AI systems. Altogether the team has co-authoring **50 + papers in top AI venues**, open-sourcing models downloaded **1.5 million+ times**, and earning **3K+ GitHub stars**.

**Majid – Co-founder & CEO**

**PhD, EPFL (ML)**. Built and led multiple AI teams, created core technologies and AI-enabled products, published research articles in top-tier venues —some featured in media. He was a **staff Scientist at Meta AI**, where he co-developed a breakthrough technology called “**Neural Databases**” and drove LLM applied research that powered customer-support automations and feed relevance across Meta’s apps. Before that, he was **staff Scientist at LinkedIn AI**, led content-understanding, job-profile matching, and economic-graph representation learning. **Former VP of Research & Technology at BYJU’S**; earlier research posts at the University of Geneva and Idiap Research Institute.

**Alireza – Co-founder & Chief Scientist**\
With a **PhD in CS/AI from EPFL** and a proven record across leading labs, he has repeatedly advanced LLM research and deployment: at **Meta AI**, he built an **LLM-driven evaluation pipeline** that boosted LLM performance on out-of-domain datasets; at **Naverlabs**, he compressed a state-of-the-art multilingual machine-translation model by 40x; at the **University of Zurich**, he introduced ensemble and contrastive decoding techniques that significantly lifted translation accuracy; and at the Idiap Research Institute, he devised methods for encoding structured data in LLMs, enhancing a range of NLP tasks. His open-source releases have collectively surpassed **one million downloads on Hugging Face**, and the underlying research has produced fifteen papers in top-tier AI conferences.

**Arshad – Co-founder & CTO**\
With an M.S. in Computer Science from Mumbai University, Arshad **bridged research and production** at BYJU’S AI Labs—building BADRI, a **multimodal transformer–based recommender** trained on 30 billion interactions. He also **engineered an inference stack** that serves over 10 million students efficiently. Prior to that, he was a deep-learning researcher at IIT Bombay.

## Our Ask

We’re lining up pilot partners in **banking, finance, and healthcare** who need AI agents that respect data sovereignty yet deepen domain expertise over time.

💡 If you know innovation leaders wrestling specifically with data and AI problems, we’d love an intro.\
👉 Contact us at [founders@leeroo.com](mailto:founders@leeroo.com) or [book a demo](https://leeroo.com/contact-us)

Help us bring continuously learning AI to the industries that need it most.

launches.tagline: 3D Lithography Foundry
launches.body:
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0n0Di5sLCjo>

**Problem**

“For the past 50 years, semiconductor-technology development has felt like walking inside a tunnel. The road ahead was clear, as there was a well-defined path. And everyone knew what needed to be done: shrink the transistor. Now, we have reached the end of the tunnel."\
H.-S. Philip Wong, Chief Scientist, TSMC, 2024.

Today’s 2D lithography has hit a fundamental wall in feature density, so the semiconductor industry has begun stacking 2D layers to fit more transistors, bits, and bandwidth on each chip. \
\
But stacking scales cost exponentially with density, unlike the constant cost days of Moore: a 10-layer high bandwidth memory (HBM) package is \~5x more expensive than the same amount of un-stacked DRAM.

**Solution**

Using a 3D process to make today's increasingly 3D integrated circuits could shortcut this problem, scaling process complexity with materials rather than layers and enabling the next decade of continued progress.

Our 3D lithography technology can do this: it is capable of fabricating multi-material 3D structures with 100 nm resolution at wafer scale.

Where the ability to create more complex forms enables more complex functions, such granular control of matter enables the future of much more than just chips, including biotech, sensing, and advanced materials.

We recently crossed the cost thresholds that make this technology commercially viable. We will be driving an exponential scaling law in the production capacity of this technology over the coming decade.

**Team**

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcMsUlRx_bo7xJvNWmZaC-39OI7Hknw0Y65Er2tjyUh54Sd4--EgCih-wQzZojhTUdUgn2OqKfPxVzmnfqnJGprg2qacYS56K-eYqnSh_n3uz75XB9uyCslMaxReWdNHhKkcVHF?key=cch75ExUod4AOIuWU2xY6A)

We’re a team of physicists and systems engineers from Caltech and NASA, where we previously matured multiple nascent technologies, winning NASA’s Most Visionary Concept and Best Product Development awards.\

launches.tagline: Willow is the future of voice-first computing...
launches.body:
Hey everyone! We're Allan and Lawrence, and we're building Willow.

**TLDR**: Willow is an AI dictation app that writes anywhere on your computer. Designed for those who rely on email, messaging, and AI prompting workflows to work 4x faster.

→ [Try it for free on Mac.](https://WillowVoice.com)

You can get set up in minutes and start dictating right away.

Launch video: https://youtu.be/8q9FRS8Km5U

### **Why we’re building Willow Voice**

We spent an entire year pivoting across different industries before landing on Willow.

We started out building for assisted living facilities. The product didn’t land, but we discovered that dictation was a tool to help them stay connected and independent. That showed us how powerful voice could be.

Then, we pivoted to building for medical clinics. We saw how AI scribes were saving doctors hours on documentation and letting them focus on patient care.

Through all these pivots, one thing became clear. Voice dictation is a superpower for anyone who types a lot. It’s 4x faster and easier than manual typing. 

Why isn’t voice the default way we interact with our computers? Because the technology just wasn’t there—until now.

That insight led us to build Willow: fast, precise, and personalized voice dictation designed for how we work today.

### **The solution: Willow Voice**

What makes Willow special is that it’s not just basic voice typing. It’s smart, fast, and sounds like _you_. Here’s how:

* **Context-awareness**: Willow looks at what you’re working on so it can get technical terms, names, and phrases right.
* **Custom dictionaries**: You can add your own words—like company names, industry terms, or team slang—so they’re always spelled correctly.
* **Smart correction and formatting**: Willow automatically fixes mistakes and adds structure—like formatting emails, breaking up paragraphs, and handling punctuation.
* **Personalization** _(beta)_: We’re working on making Willow sound just like you—adjusting tone and style depending on what you’re writing.
* **Privacy**: Willow runs in the cloud for speed and accuracy, but we never store or collect your voice or data. Privacy is our top priority, and it’s built into everything we do. There’s an optional, opt-in setting for users who want to help improve the model, completely anonymized.

It’s 40%+ more accurate than built-in dictation tools, works in under a second, and is so good that most users replace nearly all their typing with it.

### **Who’s using Willow**

People with heavy typing workflows love Willow because it helps them move faster and get more done. This includes: 

* **Engineers at YC** companies use Willow to prompt AI tools like Cursor up to 4x faster.
* **Managers at Github, Canva, and Webflow** rely on it to brainstorm, take notes, and write docs hands-free.
* **Sales teams** use Willow to reply instantly on Slack, email, and CRM tools.
* **Busy professionals** drowning in email use Willow to clear out their inbox in minutes, not hours.

### **Our ASK**

**Try Willow Voice** → [WillowVoice.com](http://WillowVoice.com)

It helps you get work done 4x faster, just by talking rather than typing.

It’s free to start and works instantly on Mac. We’d love to hear what you think!

launches.tagline: Introducing Cortex, our runtime layer which gives agents the right insights at the right moments
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Long-horizon agents break down. They can retrieve facts and utilize tools, but when it comes to long, multi-step workflows, they fail to reproduce successful behaviors and consistently repeat costly mistakes.

Aviro fixes that. We’re starting with Cortex, an RL-based intelligence layer that makes agents learn through experience. With Cortex running, our deep research agent outperformed OpenAI's—beating it by 70% on enterprise search tasks and reaching #1 on Microsoft's Deep Research benchmark.

**We're partnering with teams building advanced agents for complex business. Contact us** at [founders@aviro.ai](mailto:founders@aviro.ai) or book a time [here](https://cal.com/aarush-kukreja/demo).

https://youtu.be/8Sz16v4X63w

## Why This Matters

Agents are now being tasked with longer, higher-stakes enterprise processes, where mistakes can compound quickly, and reliability erodes rapidly. Today's agents:

* **Don't carry forward what worked**
* **Lose context across tools and handoffs**
* **Repeat the same errors** (wasting time and compute)
* **Deliver inconsistent results** teams can’t trust

They fail not because models aren't smart enough, but because agents can't learn or adapt to enterprise workflows.

## What Makes Aviro Different

Our intelligence layer, Cortex, solves this by providing task-time intelligence that evolves with your enterprise. Cortex:

* **Learns From Every Attempt -** extracts reusable lessons from long, complex runs that help future ones stay on track
* **Context-Aware Retrieval -** surfaces the right lessons at the right moments, without slowing or overloading the agent
* **Workflow-Aware Guidance -** anchors to your **existing SOPs** while evolving them as better approaches emerge
* **RL-Powered -** uses reinforcement learning to optimize guidance and retrieval over time
* **Seamless Enterprise Integration -** works alongside your current agents, models, and tools with **lightweight wiring**

With Cortex, agents identify bottlenecks early, apply proven solutions, and adapt established workflows to new scenarios without context overload. Even as complexity increases, they maintain focus and improve with each use. Our deep research agent, powered by Cortex, **outperformed OpenAI's by 70% on enterprise search tasks and topped Microsoft's Deep Research benchmark.**

## Who We're Looking For

**We're partnering with enterprise teams building advanced agents that operate across complex business processes. Reach out** at [founders@aviro.ai](mailto:founders@aviro.ai) or book a time [here](https://cal.com/aviro/demo).

launches.tagline: You build the flow. We make it unbreakable.
launches.body:
## ➡️ Meet Tropir

https://youtu.be/r9EajEr0tck

Modern AI pipelines fail constantly—hallucinations, bad retrievals, broken tool calls.

Tropir fixes that.

It traces exactly where things went wrong, suggests a targeted fix, reruns the pipeline, and tells you if the fix worked. All automatically.

## 🔁 Trace → Fix → Rerun → Evaluate → Repeat

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90937&key=user_uploads/2318975/1f24f662-f8c5-40f8-a5fa-6fbbc86ede7a)

Most observability tools stop at logs. Tropir doesn’t just show you what broke—it tells you why, applies a fix, reruns the whole pipeline, and checks if the problem’s actually solved.

You can say: “Figure out why the @last_log wasn’t grounded in retrieved context. Use @faithfulness_eval.” Or just: “This output sucks. Use the full eval set to fix it.”

Tropir handles the rest.

## 🧠 Why Tropir is Different

* Traceback Engine — Finds the root cause across prompts, retrievals, tools, and context.
* Fix + Rerun — Smart patches injected on the fly. No code rewrites.
* Built-in Evals — Relevance, grounding, structure—all tested automatically. Add your own evals if you like!
* Conversational Interface — It’s like interrogating your agent after runtime.
* Plug & Play — Two lines of code to setup Tropir and you’re done.

## 🔥 Try Tropir

Teams building RAG workflows, support bots, and research agents are shipping AI 60x faster with Tropir.\

launches.title: Blaxel — AWS for AI agents
launches.tagline: Powering the next trillion AI agents.
launches.body:
**tl;dr**: Yesterday’s cloud can’t power tomorrow’s AI. Blaxel is a cloud infrastructure built for AI agents. Our computing platform gives AI Builders tools, infra, and developer experience optimized to build and deploy agentic AI — with a twist: your agents can also take the wheel.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aISExQg14qg

### Problem

Our team of 6 co-founders previously built and sold a data platform to OVHcloud, which eventually became their entire Analytics product suite. What we saw during that time is that **the current world’s infrastructure** **wasn't built for the AI revolution that's coming**.

Traditional clouds were built almost 20 years ago. Their architecture and service sprawl weren't designed for agentic workloads. Nor was the UX thought for the developers who build them.

Not only that, but the economics don't make sense anymore. As AI agents become more autonomous, they're racking up huge bills from LLM calls, serverless tasks, and network bandwidth.

In the next decade, we're looking at billions or even trillons of AI agents coming online, each needing computing power, memory, and connectivity in every direction. The world’s current infrastructure isn't just unprepared, it's completely inadequate.

### Solution **💡**

We're creating **a new kind of infrastructure**. One that's not only built to make agents, but also to be operated by them.

Blaxel is a complete computing platform with all services designed and optimized for both AI Agents and their Developers — from the hardware to the user experience.

We offer two levels of APIs to give you full flexibility:

**1-** Our **high-level platform** lets developers to fast-track deploying agents without reinventing the wheel:

* Agent deployments as serverless autoscalable APIs — fully framework-agnostic
* MCP servers hosting
* AI gateway — with features like token rate limiting or model routing and fallbacks
* Built-in observability
* GitHub synchronization

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90942&key=user_uploads/2264960/665aa3c9-5d63-4ce6-8c16-bbb6e2c6537e)

**2-** Our flexible **low-level API** gives both builders and agents access to our core compute infrastructure to run agentic workloads fast and reliably:

* Sandboxes with <25ms boot time — designed for agents to execute code or commands
* Batch processing jobs
* Headless browser VMs _(coming soon!)_
* Programmable AI gateway _(coming soon!)_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90942&key=user_uploads/2264960/8e2c837d-f329-44b4-beec-0f80d75daa10)

Pioneering teams are already building the next wave of agents on Blaxel. Don't get left behind:

launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Nikhil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhiltiwari-iitb/) & [Shivesh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivesh-gupta-iitb/), co-founders of Frekil!  👋

## TL;DR

Frekil is an end-to-end platform to procure and annotate medical imaging datasets like Xrays, CTs, MRIs, etc 10x faster with AI assistance. We’ve partnered with radiology chains for large-scale imaging data, and have a global marketplace of radiologists for rapid, high-quality annotations.

https://youtu.be/2MYjUFp3r0Q?feature=shared

## ❗The Problem

AI is transforming healthcare, but the biggest bottleneck is still **access to medical images from hospitals and annotations by expert doctors**.

Healthcare AI and life sciences companies spend millions collecting medical images and hiring expert radiologists. But annotations? They're still:

📝 Manual\
🐢 Slow\
🔍 Hard to QA

Finding expert annotators with deep domain knowledge is tough, which means R&D teams waste months and large budgets on a process that should be seamless.

Medical annotation itself is uniquely challenging because it involves:

📦 Gigabyte-scale files\
🧠 Complex, multi-dimensional data that’s sensitive to loss\
🎯 Accuracy that’s absolutely critical

Yet most teams still use open-source desktop tools like 3D Slicer, built decades ago for solo researchers. These tools:

🚫 Require local machines\
📉 Offer no real-time collaboration\
📊 Force spreadsheet-based coordination\
🔐 Risk compliance and data security

And the result?\
Highly trained radiologists are stuck doing repetitive tasks manually wasting time, slowing innovation, and compromising data quality.

## 🧠 Our Solution

We transform the way healthcare AI teams prepare data by **accelerating and streamlining the entire annotation pipeline** — cutting timelines from months down to days.

Here’s how:

✅ Deliver fully annotated **medical datasets** tailored for AI research needs

✅ Provide certified and benchmarked **radiologists** for annotation and quality assurance

✅ Offer advanced, browser-based annotation tools for all kinds of medical images—radiology, pathology, histopathology, including X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, etc

✅ Use **AI assistance** to make annotators **10x faster**

✅ Enable customizable clinical workflows with multi-stage reviews & annotations

✅ Ensure **FDA-Ready** annotation versioning, consensus checks, and full audit trails

✅ Track annotator performance in cost, time, and **accuracy** - all built in

We’re Vaibhav and Marcello. We’re building Plexe, an open-source agent that turns natural language task descriptions into trained ML models.

https://youtu.be/CwNX0aU9MsE

## **🤔 1. Problem**

Lots of great use cases for ML models in businesses never materialize because ML projects are messy and convoluted. You spend months finding the data, cleaning it, experimenting with models and deploying them to production, only to find out that the project has been binned due to taking so long. At a previous employer, we witnessed a team of 10 ML engineers spend 2 years and $3M building models for a project that never saw the light of day. 

There are several tools for “automating” ML, but it still takes teams of ML experts to actually productionize something of value. And we can’t keep throwing LLMs at every ML problem. Why use a generic 10B parameter language model, if a logistic regression trained on your data could do the job better?

## **✅ 2. Solution**

Step 1: Connect your data sources\
Step 2: Describe your problem statement\
Step 3: Use the deployed model via API

https://youtu.be/zByvH0wTSuE

## **🚀 3. How does it work?**

Plexe uses a self-correcting team of ML engineering agents to research, experiment, evaluate, refine, and deploy the best performing model over an API endpoint. It connects to data sources, discovering relevant fields, and autonomously building the model. Think of it like your own ML helper helping you go from idea to deployed models 10x faster.

https://youtu.be/bUwCSglhcXY

## **👋 4. Team**

[Vaibhav Dubey](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2260416) (ex-Proofpoint, Expedia, Imperial College London) and [Marcello De Bernardi](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2337737) (ex-AWS, Expedia, Oxford) met 6 years ago while building a chatbot that served 9+ million customers of a large bank. Since then, they’ve built enterprise-scale ML solutions that serve billions of predictions per day for millions of users worldwide.

launches.body:
Hey YC! \
We are [Tim](https://www.linkedin.com/in/timmichaud/) and [Aaksha](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aaksham/) - cofounders of Kashikoi. [Kashikoi](https://www.getkashikoi.com) is a simulation engine to benchmark GenAI Agents. We generate CPU friendly world models that autonomously interview agents and generate deep behavioral assessments.

# **The Problem**

Building high-performing AI agents is becoming increasingly complex. Teams face many challenges:

* Managing prompt bloat and keeping up with endless prompt tuning cycles.
* Evaluating their agents (or competitors') meaningfully and efficiently.
* Understanding agent performance in ways that reflect real-world values and expectations—not just public benchmarks.

Despite growing interest and investment, most solutions rely heavily on prompt engineering, public benchmarks, or surface-level observability. These approaches often mislead more than they inform, creating a false sense of progress.

# **The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90990&key=user_uploads/267393/5573f5c1-baf0-4fc5-b58f-d6fc289fb8f2)

Today’s “LLMs” are adaptive systems which run test time adaptation loops behind that tiny “Thinking…” blinking on the screen. We are building a scalable version of test time adaptation and inference scaling a.k.a World Models that bring the power of these techniques to you.

Simply put you can simulate highly customized benchmarks, diverse data and align your evaluations while maintaining all of these for the long run, all without writing prompts! Our world models unlock automatic prompt optimization and detecting regression test staleness as fun side effects.

LLM based Systems are getting smarter and so should you using our World models!

Check out our simulation engine adaptively interviewing RAG Agents and multi-turn evaluation in action [here](https://www.loom.com/share/7b3bdb899b06433fbc0636df487c6133?sid=6dd87cdc-495e-48e4-bb7a-971b1430cae5).

# Why Us

* Tim and Aaksha used similar world models tech at Moveworks to massively reduce dev cycles for shipping 250+ customized enterprise ready agents.
* Aaksha has done cutting edge research in Transformers at CMU (long before OpenAI made them cool). She shipped edge speech models on 1bn+ iPhones. The innovation behind these models was published as a paper at Interspeech 2021 and nominated for a Best Paper Award that same year.
* Tim has found many high impact security vulnerabilities throughout his career. One of his top bug discoveries was in all Qualcomm GPS chips leading to a 50 mile 0-click exploit that had no mitigations. Tim has many [public CVEs](https://www.inulledmyself.com/2023/05/using-ai-to-find-software.html) for a variety of Apple products, including: Safari, MacOS, iOS, tvOS, & iTunes.

# Our Ask

Sign up for our waitlist at [getkashikoi.com](http://getkashikoi.com), or email us at [founders@getkashikoi.com](mailto:founders@getkashikoi.com) if you or someone you know wants:

* Instant evals on your agent (or a competitor’s 😉) and we’ll generate [such a report](https://www.notion.so/NewAgent-Benchmark-Report-1db104cde9e88066b62ac3d68fb6c878?pvs=21) for you.
* Making advanced features—like automatic prompt optimization, world models, and inference scaling—work seamlessly for you.
* Reliable prompt free evaluations that are aligned with your values and expectations (which we auto-encode in a special edge-friendly world model for you).
* Don’t come to us if:
  * You love writing prompts
  * You trust public benchmarks
  * You think that good observability is enough to make your agent win
  * You aren’t ready to have an honest conversation about your agents’ performance
* Jokes aside 😅, if you know enterprises building agents suffering from prompt bloat, please (pretty please 🥺) send them our way!

# The unsolved problem:

Fast‑growing teams drown in \_glue work\_—onboarding trackers, launch calendars, status bots, one‑off scripts. Each steals engineering time, rots when its owner leaves, and derails sprints.

It leaves companies with three bad options:

* Rigid enterprise SaaS – inflexible, forces your process to fit the tool.
* Spreadsheets & docs – endless copy‑paste, no live data, fragile at scale.
* DIY glue & drag‑and‑drop no‑code – a tangle of scripts and widgets that collapse when owners leave.

# **Why current vibe coding tools aren’t enough:**

Vibe coding is dramatically lowering the barrier for non-technical users to create full web apps. Lovable, Replit, Bolt, Google, Canva, Figma all launched their vibe-coding platforms. People love them. They're great for prototyping, but it's difficult to roll out inside a company for internal use cases for those reasons:

* Data: If you want to connect your existing data (e.g. Salesforce, Gmail, Jira), you'd need to rebuild the API auth, pagination, etc.
* SSO: If you build 20 apps, you'll have 20 different logins…
* Security: AI-built apps have the massive risk of exposing data, especially if built by non-developers

Cursor and Windsurf are not adapted either. They’re built for devs, hard to use for non-technical folks. My Head of HR doesn’t know how to deploy an app in Netlify or Vercel.

# **Why old no-code tools are solutions of the past:**

* Airtable / Retool / Coda: No‑code and low‑code platforms showed you can build dashboards faster than hand‑coding React—but you're still dragging rectangles, hunting for SQL, and rebuilding the same CRUD table for the hundredth time.
* Large‑language models have changed the game. Code‑gen IDEs already write production‑grade functions from chat—so why are we still moving boxes to connect Salesforce to a launch‑approval form?

launches.body:
**🥷 Manifesto**

Data teams have been left out of the vibe coding party. We’re building nao so they can **data vibe** too.

**🏎 TL;DR**

nao is an **AI code editor to write code on data**: a local editor, connected to your data warehouse, with an AI copilot that has context of both your data schema and codebase.\
It’s built specifically for data workflows - helping teams write faster, better code, while being ensured of the data quality.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90397&key=user_uploads/1535815/f9051a44-1d1e-41a0-b995-e6bcb94a4c31)

**🧑‍💻 Who is it for?**

* **Data teams** who run analytics with SQL and build dbt or Python pipelines
* **Software developers** who manage SQL databases

**🤖 What can you do with nao?**

You can prompt nao **AI agent** to:

* **Create SQL queries & dbt models** from your data warehouse tables
* Add **documentation & testing** to your data
* **Refactor** your codebase through your **lineage**
* Perform **data quality checks**, **data diff** tests
* Run **conversational analytics**

**nao AI tab auto-suggests code for your data** — only with tables, columns and data that actually exist in your warehouse.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90397&key=user_uploads/1535815/08d1f6f0-b247-4887-b179-c0f5f2cd8405)

**🔆 Why we built it**

Christophe and Claire have each spent 10 years in data. We’ve seen that data teams can’t keep the business pace because making changes in data requires too many tools and tests.\
Current AI code editors don’t interact natively with data warehouses — they autocomplete SQL blindly, not knowing your data schema. We built nao so that data teams can ship at business pace, with an AI code editor that has all their context.

**👀 Watch it live**

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QmG6X-5ftZU](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QmG6X-5ftZU&ab_channel=ClaireGouze)

launches.tagline: We provide the tooling to build and operate MCP servers in production - auth, tracing, and a deployment pipeline included.
launches.body:
Hi YC,

We’re Wojciech and Antoni -  high school friends who’ve been building together since we were 14. We're incredibly bullish on a future where AI agents have their own internet through which they access our services - so much so that we dropped out of university to build Golf.

**Golf lets you ship a production-ready MCP server without worrying about the plumbing.** You just write the tools, prompts, and resources you want agents to call. Golf handles everything else - routing, auth, telemetry, error reporting, and deployment. Then you can observe and manage it through our gateway.

https://youtu.be/u9ar4w2uE7E

# **The problem**

Over the past few weeks, we spoke with over 40 teams building MCP servers. Everyone hit the same walls: wiring up authentication, figuring out how to trace agent calls, setting up working transports, and debugging behavior in production. The MCP spec doesn’t cover these parts. Teams told us it takes **2-4 weeks** to get that to production.

# **What we built**

**GolfMCP** is an open-source framework that gives you a clear, file-based structure to define what your agent can call. No decorators, no spec knowledge, no boilerplate - just write your logic.

**Golf Gateway** is the hosted layer that runs and observes your server. golf deploy gives you a live server in under 60 seconds, with real-time traces, tool usage, and error monitoring built in.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90569&key=user_uploads/1366358/b035bdc4-02c2-42d5-a230-ad38be34dfa9)

We’re already running Golf in production with companies, and we’ve got more landing this week.

Also we’d love to get your feedback, and we’re happy to help teams get to production faster. Reach us at [founders@golf.dev](mailto:founders@golf.dev)

Code review is a major bottleneck for software teams, and the rise of AI-generated code is making the problem worse. Reviewing large volumes of code slows devs down, and increases the chances of bugs slipping through.

That's why we're building cubic: an intelligent code review platform that helps devs merge PRs 28% faster.

How? 
- When you open a PR, cubic automatically reviews it. It learns from your codebase's patterns, points out bugs, suggesting fixes, and frees you from low-level review tasks.
- You then jump into the cubic platform, which is designed to optimize how humans review code. For example, file changes are organized in a logical order instead of alphabetical, and cubic generates diagrams of architecture changes.

launches.body:
**🎯 TL;DR**

cubic is an AI-powered code review platform that automatically reviews PRs and gives human reviewers superpowers.

It helps teams like [**cal.com**](http://cal.com), **n8n**, and the **Linux Foundation** ship code 28% faster.

https://youtu.be/7bzIJYy0Nfw

Hey! 👋 We’re Allis and Paul – founders of cubic.

We’re building cubic – an AI code review platform to help teams ship code faster with fewer bugs.

[🚀 See it in action for cal.com here](https://github.com/calcom/cal.com/pull/20771)

🎁 **Launch deal**

If you’re a developer, and you feel like code reviews are slowing you down + bugs slip through, give cubic a try.

It’s free for 2 weeks, and you’ll get an extra 30% off for 2 months with the code: _YCLAUNCH_

[**Just sign up with your Github account to get started!**](http://cubic.dev/home)

**⭐️ Why did we start cubic?**

We’re engineers who faced this problem when we worked together in the past. As we adopted more AI code gen tools, code review and ensuring quality quickly became our biggest bottleneck.

We had more PRs to review, subtle AI-written bugs slipped in, and we (humans) found ourselves rubber-stamping PRs without deeply understanding the changes.

**👷 We’re building cubic to help solve that. Here’s how it works:**

1. Connect your GitHub repo via our Github app in two clicks
2. AI review: When you open a PR, our AI reviews your changes directly in a secure container. It has context into not just that PR, but your whole codebase, so it can pick up patterns and leave comments directly on changed lines. Once the review is done, the sandbox is torn down and your code deleted.
3. Human-friendly review workflow: Jump into our web (or desktop) app (it’s like Linear but for PRs). Changes are grouped logically (not alphabetically), with important diffs highlighted, visualized, and ready for faster human review.

💻 The AI reviewer works a bit like Cursor in the sense that it navigates your codebase using the same tools a developer would—like jumping to definitions or grepping through code.

⚡️ The platform itself focuses entirely on making _human_ code reviews easier. A big inspiration came from productivity-focused apps like Linear or Superhuman, products that show just how much thoughtful design can impact everyday workflows. We wanted to bring that same feeling to code review.

That’s one reason we built a desktop app. It allowed us to deliver a more polished experience, complete with keyboard shortcuts and a snappy interface.

We think the future of coding isn’t about AI replacing humans—it’s about giving us better tools to quickly understand high-level changes, abstracting more and more of the code itself. As code volume continues to increase, this shift is going to become increasingly important.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pWBvyPugoFQ

# **Insurance Claims Processing is Manual and Slow**

Insurance adjusters are drowning in manual work to process claims. This creates delays, errors, and frustrated policyholders while burying adjusters in tedious work instead of decision-making. Adjusters face three major bottlenecks:

* **Fragmented communication:** Adjusters spend hours fielding routine calls and emails to gather and relay claim information. Phone tag with claimants, vendors, and internal teams creates delays and frustration.
* **Slow document review:** Sifting through unstructured documents, photos, and reports to validate evidence is time-intensive. Manual review of complex documentation slows case resolution.
* **Tedious record keeping:** Converting notes and decisions into structured data for claims management systems requires constant manual data entry.

An aging workforce exacerbates these issues, creating a talent shortage as workloads grow. With median adjuster compensation already at $109k and razor-thin margins for carriers and TPAs, the economics of manual processing are unsustainable.

# **Meet Avallon: Your Team of AI Claims Agents**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90754&key=user_uploads/1970255/9c370a61-6191-4f21-aa57-1c007b5cedfc)

Avallon's AI agents plug directly into existing claims management systems and automate these tedious tasks, helping adjusters resolve cases more quickly. Our AI agents work autonomously to handle:

* **Communication workflows:** Our agents handle routine calls and emails, gathering claim information while eliminating phone tag and keeping all parties updated.
* **Document analysis:** Our AI instantly processes unstructured documents, photos, and reports, extracting key data points and validating coverage details in seconds.
* **Data management:** Our agents automatically convert all findings into structured data and populate your claims management system, eliminating manual data entry and errors.

Avallon’s intelligent agents turn claims management from reactive to proactive, helping adjusters make faster decisions, reduce errors, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

## **Team:**

The team met as grad students at Cornell studying computer science and operations research.

* **Cornelius** had previously built the complete ops infrastructure to scale FINN US from 0 to $15M ARR as a founding engineer at the car subscription platform. There he saw firsthand how broken fleet claims processes are.

* **Jet** studied quantitative trading algorithms, is a national champion policy debater, and taught debate at the Taipei American School.

During a fall break hiking trip, the team brainstormed startup ideas until Avallon took shape. They shipped the first version around Christmas, landed their first customer weeks later, and dropped out to pursue the company full-time.

* **Insurance company executives and claims leaders** who want faster, smarter claim resolutions.
* **Industry advisors and operators** passionate about digitizing and modernizing insurance processes.

If you’re ready to streamline your claims operations with AI, email us at [founders@avallon.ai](mailto:founders@avallon.ai) or schedule a demo at [avallon.ai](http://avallon.ai).

Let’s put AI to work to fix insurance.

Hi! We’re [**Mehul Shah**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mehulmshah22), [**Nick Warren**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nickcw/), [**Matthew Noseworthy**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthew-noseworthy-218167106/) — co-founders of [**GroundControl**](https://rungroundcontrol.com/).

**TL;DR** — We've onboarded 70+ manufacturing facilities as customers throughout the US. Our core product automates lengthy, complex, and regulated quality documentation in aerospace manufacturing.

**How We Started**

Nick and Matt co-founded their last startup (InspectAR) with Mehul's brother before being acquired by Cadence ($CDNS). I (Mehul) spent the last decade in my family business, where we built PCBs for every advanced system on Earth: rockets, satellites, aircraft, fighter jets, and more. We noticed despite building for innovation, manufacturing operations were antiquated and bogged down with manual processes.

First Article Inspection Reports (AS9102s) were creating a bottleneck in quality. Parts would be built and ready to ship, just waiting on paperwork. Our facilities were doing 15 reports a day, 8 hours per report. The worst part? Even if the part was built exactly to spec — if a single typo was found by the customer, the report would get rejected and payment delayed until the report was fixed.

**What We Built**

Our core product automates first article inspection reporting for regulated manufacturing. Quality teams can balloon drawings and automate inspection report generation in minutes, instead of days.

**Our Vision**

Today, over 70 facilities across the US generate almost 1000 reports a month on our platform. This is just the beginning. We'll continue to build for quality, and upstream towards operations, engineering, and sales to empower manufacturers with AI. GroundControl will embed itself across the global supply chain, from Tier 4 suppliers to OEMs with vertically integrated manufacturing.

launches.body:
**Industrial Sales teams are underwater. Here’s why - and what we’re doing to fix it.**

Hi everyone! We’re [Smit](https://www.linkedin.com/in/smitdagli/) and [Vik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vikhyath-m-a00357128/) - the founders of [Kanava AI](https://kanava.ai/)

**Problem and Opportunity:**

The wholesale distribution industry is massive: _$9T+ in annual revenue. 410,000+ businesses. 6 million+ employees._

And yet — sales teams are drowning.

* **A third of the workforce is over 55**, and replacements aren’t coming fast enough.

  (“Most of my sales reps are **retiring in the next 2-3 years**, I have **NO idea** what I’ll do after” - a medium sized electrical goods distributor from Indiana we met)
* **Reps spend less than 30% of their time selling**. The rest? Answering repetitive calls (“What’s the price of this SKU?” “Which warehouse has it?”), digging through systems, and manual follow-ups.
* **Over 25% of inbound calls never reach a human** — lost revenue, lost trust, lost time.

This isn’t just inefficiency. It’s operational drag at scale — and it's only getting worse.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s1NVVxRnLL8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s1NVVxRnLL8%5C%5C)

**How’re we solving it:**

We’re building Kanava AI, a voice-based AI agent designed for wholesale distributors.

It handles repetitive tasks like **answering stock, price,** and **order status calls** using live **ERP** data and logging **field notes hands-free**, drafting follow-ups, updating the **CRM** all _automatically_.

It’s like a junior rep-in-training. It starts with the basics, but improves quickly by learning from the company’s best performers. Over time, Kanava takes on more:

•⁠ **⁠Managing consultative sales calls** \
•⁠ ⁠**Identifying upsell opportunities** in real time \
•⁠ ⁠**Surfacing coaching insights** from rep conversations \
•⁠ ⁠**Re-engaging dormant accounts** with timely, data-backed outreach

And by the time these reps are ready to retire, Kanava is **ready to fill the void they leave.**

Most AI tools in this space fail because they try to do too much, too early, and distributors are famously late adopters. We’re taking a more deliberate path: start with low-leverage work, prove value, and scale responsibility as the system earns it.

**Our Team**

Vik (CTO) and Smit (CEO) know each other since freshman year of college at UC Berkeley. Both of us studied CS, and worked as AI engineers at various startups before deciding to build our own thing and join YC.

**Smit:** Built incident resolution agents at a series B observability startup called Observe. Previously worked at Abnormal Security and Salesforce.

**Vik**: Built voice agents for numerical data entry and hands-free navigation for a data management platform called Uncountable. Previously worked at Uber and Amazon.

We’re both outsiders to the wholesale distribution industry, but we’re listening hard and learning fast.

What made us really want to work together was being on the same ultimate frisbee team in the senior year of college - that team was a disaster, we lost every single game we played by huge margins, but despite that, we had a ton of fun and stuck together!

* **Integrates everywhere.** From Stripe to Shopify, Slack to WhatsApp—if it holds financial signal, it’s in scope.

launches.tagline: c/ua runs lightweight containers for Computer-Use AI Agents with your own language models.
launches.body:
### **📚 TL;DR**

**c/ua** is an open-source framework that enables AI agents to control full operating systems within high-performance, lightweight virtual containers. It delivers up to **97% native CPU speed on Apple Silicon** and works with any language models: [**https://github.com/trycua/cua**](https://github.com/trycua/cua).

<https://youtu.be/Ee9qf-13gho>

### **⚒️ The Problem**

For **Computer-Use AI agents** to be genuinely useful, they must interact with your system's native applications. But giving full access to your host device is **risky** - and not ideal. What if the agent's process gets compromised, or the LLM hallucinates and leaks your data? And practically speaking, do you really want to **give up control** of your entire machine just so the agent can do its job?

**In short: How can AI agents interact with operating systems, desktop applications, and browsers without jeopardizing security or sacrificing performance?**

### **⭐ Solution: An end-to-end framework**

We combined **Apple's Virtualization.Framework** with an agent-friendly interface to create:

\- **Lightweight VMs**: Run at 97% of native CPU speed on Apple Silicon, giving you near-native performance in a secure, virtualized space.

\- **Sandboxed Execution**: AI agents operate in tightly controlled environments, allowing secure interaction with desktop applications - without risking your host system.

\- **LLM-Compatible Runtimes**: Works out-of-the-box with popular LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-source tools like Ollama, LM Studio, and OpenRouter.

And we now support **MCP**! You can use Claude Desktop or Cursor, as your personal assistant to navigate even notoriously challenging apps like Tableau. Watch the demo to see it in action!

[**https://youtu.be/NTUVU1aBs3c**](https://youtu.be/NTUVU1aBs3c)

### **⚙️ How It Works**

**c/ua** brings together three powerful components into one unified framework stack:

1\. **Lume** - Our high-performance Virtualization layer leverages Apple's Virtualization.Framework to spin up macOS or Linux environments.

2\. **Computer-Use Interface (CUI)** - This layer lets any process or AI agent - no matter which framework it's built on (like AutoGen, LangGraph, etc.) - see the screen and interact with Lume VMs just like a human would. It supports actions such as clicking, typing, scrolling, and extracting the visual accessibility tree.

3\. **Computer-Use Agent (CUA)** - Built on top of CUI, this general agent framework runs intelligent workflows within these VMs. It's compatible with popular LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, as well as open-source tools like Ollama, LM Studio, and OpenRouter.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89628&key=user_uploads/1644303/c3e0e845-3223-4b82-85d1-316e41d9875c)

An AI agent built with **c/ua** operates within a virtual environment to:

\- Navigate and interact with any application's interface

\- Read screen content and perform keyboard/mouse actions

\- Switch between applications and self-debug when needed

\- Operate in a secure sandbox with controlled file access

All of this occurs in a fully isolated environment, ensuring your host system, files, and sensitive data remain completely secure - while you continue using your device without interruption.

### **🖥️ What Can You Build with c/ua?**

**c/ua** lets AI agents use real desktop apps - just like a human. For example:

\- **CAD Copilot**: Modify 3D models in tools like Fusion 360 or FreeCAD.

\- **Photoshop Assistant**: Crop, layer, and export assets via prompt.

\- **Operator for Tableau**: Navigate dashboards and filters with natural language.

\- **Legacy App Automator**: Control apps and websites with no APIs through UI actions.

### **🤝 Our Asks:**

If you're done burning money on fragile browser automations or slow, over-engineered computer-use agents - it's time to try c/ua:

* Book a call: <https://cal.com/francesco-bonacci/cua-demo>
* Email us: [founders@trycua.com](mailto:founders@trycua.com)

Also don’t forget to:

1\. Leave us a star, watch and fork on GitHub: [**https://github.com/trycua/cua**](https://github.com/trycua/cua)

2\. Join our Discord [**https://discord.com/invite/mVnXXpdE85**](https://discord.com/invite/mVnXXpdE85) - we're building this together

https://youtu.be/sTh-Af8mAx4

Can’t wait get started? Email us at [founders@galenai.com](mailto:founders@galenai.com) to join our private beta and start getting health insights today!

**💥 The Problem**

For 4+ years now, I’ve struggled to navigate several chronic low back conditions. I often waited weeks for responses from my care team, received little guidance about new diagnoses, and felt overwhelmed trying to manage overlapping conditions and medications.

I found myself turning to ChatGPT. A lot. And quickly, Priyanka and I realized my experience is not unique…it’s the norm. Our healthcare system is overloaded and fragmented, doctors are pressed for time, and patients are expected navigate the majority of it alone.

Increasingly, **patients are trusting LLMs with their health questions**, but these tools weren’t built to understand a person’s full clinical history, wearable data, and evolving health context, so they fall short of delivering truly personalized insights.

**🧠 Our Solution**

Meet Galen AI — our AI-powered solution to make high-quality, personal medical support accessible to everyone. No more screenshotting your records and uploading them to ChatGPT. No more WebMD rabbit holes about your symptoms. No more waiting months for your next doctor’s appointment.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90700&key=user_uploads/1833511/b89751e0-80e4-479d-aa23-bf7209579b13)

It also syncs with your **Apple Watch** to bring in daily fitness and activity data, with support for **20+ additional wearables** coming soon.

As you share new symptoms and health updates, Galen **keeps track** and **continuously learns** about your evolving needs, providing long-term support.

Once your records are connected, you can:

* Receive clear, **comprehensive summaries** of your medical history
* Ask questions about and **uncover patterns** in your health data
* **Understand new symptoms** in the context of your existing conditions
* **Receive tailored insights** about medication side effects or interactions, comorbidities, and treatment impacts

We met working on a class project at Stanford and haven’t stopped building together since.

Priyanka, originally pre-med, conducted clinical and biocomputation research at Stanford SAIL, Cleveland Clinic, and UCLA, and worked as a software engineer at Roche. I worked as an engineer at Optiver and quantitative trader at IMC Trading before developing a strong interest in healthcare through my personal experiences.

We both pursued a BS/MS in Computer Science from Stanford and have collaborated on several AI and healthcare projects, including a mobile app for cancer patients with the Stanford Center of Biodesign.

Hey everyone, we’re [Arjun](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arjun-lalwani/) & [Helly](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hellyshah/), co-founders of Ralo. 👋

**TL;DR**\
[Ralo](https://ralo.com/) **is America’s first mortgage platform built to help homebuyers save time, money, and stress.** We automate the hardest parts of getting a mortgage so buyers can lock in the lowest rates with the least hassle.

# **The Mortgage Problem**

A huge number of buyers still do not shop their mortgage, even though doing so can save serious money. The main reason is not laziness. The process is overwhelming.\
**High friction** \
Comparing lenders usually means re-entering the same information, re-uploading the same documents, and navigating multiple portals with different requirements and timelines.

**Lack of know-how** \
Most people do not know what they can negotiate or how to compare offers. Terms like points, credits, and relationship pricing add confusion. Switching later can feel risky if it might slow down or jeopardize the deal.

**Spam overload** \
Trying to shop for a mortgage can quickly turn into a flood of calls and emails.

# **What Ralo Does**

Ralo reimagines how mortgages work.

**One form. One Workflow.** \
You fill out one application. We keep everything organized and guide you from pre-approval through closing.

**Lowest Rates From the Start** \
Yes, we can negotiate. More importantly, we streamline the process and remove middlemen so buyers can access great rates with low fees upfront, without endless back-and-forth.

**Zero Spam**\
We protect buyer data and only share what is necessary, so getting a mortgage does not become an inbox nightmare.

**Proof in the Rates**\
We publish our rates here: [ralo.com/rates](https://ralo.com/rates). On average, Ralo’s rates are about 0.50 percent to 0.75 percent below the market average, often with lower fees too

Know someone buying a home? Send them to [ralo.com](https://ralo.com). It could help them save thousands.

Know any real estate agents or lenders? We're also looking to connect with real estate agents and loan officers who would be open to sharing feedback. 📩 Connect us at [**founders@ralo.com**](mailto:founders@ralo.com)

Want to support? A follow or shoutout on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/approval-ai/) means the world.

Thanks so much for your support. It makes a big difference to us!

Ralo was founded by ex-Google and first time homebuyers in different cities who bonded over how confusing, expensive, and frustrating getting a mortgage was.

[Arjun](https://www.linkedin.com/in/arjun-lalwani/) (CEO) — previously worked as a Product Manager at Google (APM '20), where he led high-impact consumer products. Hello! We're **Acolite** ([acolite.ai](http://acolite.ai)) — an AI-native **commercial insurance brokerage** built for contractors and trade businesses. We pair licensed brokers with AI teammates so clients get specialist expertise at software speed: same-day COIs, faster quotes, and brokers who actually know your trade.

Forward an email or call your broker — Acolite handles the rest.

### **The problem**

Construction insurance is getting harder.

Contractors are dealing with rising premiums, carrier pullback, stricter contract requirements, more certificate requests, workers’ comp audits, action-over exclusions, subcontractor risk, and project owners asking for very specific coverage language.

At the same time, most brokers still operate the old way: manual applications, slow turnaround, limited coverage review, and little visibility into whether a policy actually matches the contractor’s risk.

That creates real problems:

* Contractors overpay for coverage that may not protect them
* Contracts get delayed because COIs or endorsements are wrong
* Workers’ comp audits lead to surprise bills
* Gaps in GL, auto, umbrella, or subcontractor coverage show up only after a claim
* Business owners spend too much time chasing insurance instead of running jobs

### **What Acolite does today**

Acolite combines the traditional relationship-driven brokerage model with AI behind the scenes.

We help contractors:

* Review existing policies and identify coverage gaps
* Shop general liability, workers’ comp, commercial auto, umbrella, excess, and other construction policies
* Compare quotes across carriers
* Analyze contracts and insurance requirements
* Check COIs, endorsements, additional insured language, waiver of subrogation, and primary & non-contributory requirements
* Prepare cleaner submissions so carriers can quote faster
* Navigate audits, renewals, and mid-term changes

Our goal is simple: help contractors get the right coverage at the right price, without the usual back-and-forth.

### **Who we serve**

We’re starting with construction because the pain is obvious and urgent.

If you’re searching for contractor insurance, general contractor insurance, electrical contractor insurance, roofing contractor insurance, HVAC contractor insurance, concrete contractor insurance, solar contractor insurance, or workers’ comp for contractors, we can help.

### **Our ask**

* If you’re a contractor, developer, or construction business owner, email me at [daniel@acolite.ai](mailto:daniel@acolite.ai) — I’m happy to review your current insurance and see if we can improve it.

### **⚠️ The Problem: You're Invisible Where It Matters**

LLMs like ChatGPT are changing how people discover brands. Most companies have **zero visibility** into how often they’re mentioned, what queries they rank for, or which competitors are winning.

That means:

* **You don’t know what LLMs are saying about you (or not saying).**
* **You don’t know how to improve it.**
* **You’re losing qualified traffic to better-optimized competitors.**

---

### **🛠️ Meet Anvil - LLM SEO for the AI Era**

We help companies **track, analyze, and grow their visibility** inside LLM platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.

✅ **Monitor** your brand’s performance across thousands of user queries\
📊 **Benchmark** against competitors and discover where you're falling behind\

launches.tagline: HelixDB is a graph-vector database that brings structure to your un-structured data for RAG and AI applications.
launches.body:
Hi everyone 👋

We’re [George](https://www.linkedin.com/in/george-curtis-12b232a5/) and [Xav](https://www.linkedin.com/in/xaviercochran/) – co-founders of [HelixDB](https://www.helix-db.com)

# TL;DR

**HelixDB is an open-source graph-vector database that brings structure to your un-structured data for RAG and AI applications.**

**_ASK:_** Can you introduce us to people/companies that are working on Graph/Hybrid RAG that could benefit from better performance or less overhead in their development cycles? Contact me at [george@helix-db.com](https://mailto:george@helix-db.com)

https://youtu.be/V5viTRj2h68

# ❌ The Problem

AI is changing at a rapid rate which is fundamentally changing technology. This new tech **_needs_** new infrastructure.

Everyone is trying to build AI applications, which often involve dedicated data retrieval for their specific use case. Building these retrieval systems is hard. Previously, we’ve relied solely on vector databases to retrieve semantic matches on tiny snippets of text data. But, this technology is shifting and is relying more heavily on connected data, which comes with better context.

But building these retrieval systems often involve:

1. **Vector databases**
2. **Graph databases**
3. Bespoke **middleman/syncing** software

These setups are complicated, take a lot of time, engineering expertise, and create huge amounts of overhead which makes maintaining them very time consuming and expensive.

# ✅ Our Solution

HelixDB integrates semantic meaning (through its vector types) with relationships to other data (graph types), a similar model to how we structure information in our brains.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90705&key=user_uploads/1342245/468263b3-fb06-4efe-9352-4c30923c6d10)

This makes it the best solution for making AI retrieval engines for agents and LLMs.

How we currently do this:

1. Seamlessly integrate **vector types** into your **knowledge graph**
2. **Type-safe query language** that guides developers and agents to write correct queries before they are executed
3. **Extreme speeds** outperforming industry leaders by 1-3 orders of magnitude

How we’re going to make it better:

1. **MCP tools** that allow agents to walk the graph themselves, deciding at each step how to traverse the graph based on the schema and available data.
2. Built-in **ingestion pipelines** for multi-modal data.
3. Built-in **embedding-models** bringing immediate structure to your knowledge graph.

To get setup, follow the guide in our README:\
[HelixDB Github](https://github.com/helixdb/helix-db)

# 🙏🏻 Our Ask

* Can you introduce us to people/companies that are working on Graph/Hybrid RAG that could benefit from better performance or less overhead in their development cycles? Get them to [book a call](https://cal.com/georgec/30min) or email [george@helix-db.com](https://mailto:george@helix-db.com)

Your help and support makes a huge difference for this project. **Thank you!**

Hi 👋 this is [Jannik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jannik-grothusen/) - Founder of The Robot Learning Company.

**TL;DR:** We make automation accessible to businesses with an affordable, general-purpose robot platform designed to automate repetitive, stationary tasks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91187&key=user_uploads/2427273/0797ea73-9264-46d4-b089-731c1ec76f89)

# The Problem

**Traditional automation is broken** for tasks outside of factories. It’s expensive, rigid, and slow to deploy. Each new use-case demands a custom $100,000+ integration, months of setup, and only works in tightly controlled environments.

**General-purpose robots promise to change that**. The dream: drop-in systems that replace expensive human labor with cheap, flexible robotic labor. But in reality, most general robotic systems don’t justify their cost. The math doesn’t work:

**_Value = Human labor saved – Robot cost_**

Today, robots lose this equation in two key areas:

* Low productivity: they don’t save enough labor
* Hardware, setup, and training costs are too high

The future doesn’t need more traditional robotic arms - it needs smarter, cheaper ones that can adapt quickly.

# Our Solution

We’re building affordable and easy-to-deploy general-purpose robotic workers.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-_uDCFCBDaE

We combine:

* **Low-cost hardware**: a pair of stationary robotic arms for under $10,000
* **Self-learning control software**: we use imitation learning and offline reinforcement learning to adapt the robot to new tasks and environments from just a handful of demonstrations

This makes robotic automation accessible to a far broader set of businesses - even ones that previously couldn’t justify the investment.

# About Us

I’m [Jannik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jannik-grothusen/), a former robot learning researcher at UC Berkeley and TU Munich, with a degree in Mechatronics. I’ve contributed to frontier open-source projects in robotic manipulation, and my work in the space has been [featured by TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2024/11/04/built-in-four-days-this-120-robot-arm-cleans-a-spill-with-help-from-gpt-4o/).

Hey everyone! We’re [Luca](https://www.linkedin.com/in/luca-martial/) and [Andrey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andreyavtomonov/), the founders of Kaelio.

**TL;DR**:

Kaelio is the company behind **ktx**, the open-source context engine for data agents. Claude Code, Codex, and custom data agents can write SQL that _looks_ reasonable, _runs_ fine, and still returns the wrong number.

ktx gives them a context layer: Markdown wiki pages for business knowledge, YAML files for executable metric definitions, joins, grain, measures, dimensions, filters, and segments. Agents ask ktx for the metric they need; ktx plans the query and compiles SQL.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5V4TuzYVlrA>

# The problem

Agents are good at exploring schemas and writing SQL that _looks_ correct and _runs_ fine, but always ends up using the wrong joins, filters, or metric logic.

To cite a few examples of “agents gone wrong”:

* Stale column + hidden business rule: when preparing a board report, a finance analyst asks Claude Code for “ARR by customer segment”, it derives ARR from multiple tables (subscriptions, plans, accounts), then groups by accounts.industry. But CC doesn’t know that this industry column was deprecated a few months prior, or that past board reports excluded paused subscriptions from the ARR calculation
* Join fanout: a data analyst at a retailer uses their company’s internal agent to prep a product revenue deck for a QBR. The agent joins orders to order_items, then sums orders.total \_amount_cents grouped by order_items.product_id. The SQL runs fine, but each order’s revenue is repeated once per line item, which most people will miss if most orders only have 1 item
* Missing attribution logic: a marketing analyst asks Codex “Which campaigns drove the most revenue?” Codex joins marketing_touches to users to orders and groups by utm_campaign. But since each order can have multiple touches before purchase, the same order can be credited to first touch, last touch, every touch, or every campaign the user clicked before buying. If the agent chooses the method that doesn’t match the team’s attribution logic, they’ll make suboptimal decisions

The issue is that schema access doesn’t tell an agent which metric definition is approved, which dimension is stale, or what jargon the company uses internally.

# How ktx works

ktx splits context into 2 parts:

1. **Business context**: Markdown wiki pages (definitions, conventions, jargon, gotchas).
2. **Executable definitions**: YAML files declaring tables, row grain, joins, measures, dimensions, filters, and filter groups.

Both are plain files in git.

When an agent needs a metric, it asks ktx for a measure + dimensions + filters instead of writing SQL itself. ktx’s planner picks the join path, uses grain and relationship metadata, catches issues like join fanout and chasm joins, and compiles the warehouse SQL.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102087&key=user_uploads/765285/a2205b17-21b1-4b6e-9eac-2bfa26548391)

ktx can ingest context from:

* Warehouses: Postgres, Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, _(more coming)_
* Modeling tools: dbt, MetricFlow, LookML, _(more coming)_
* BI tools: Looker, Metabase, _(more coming)_
* Docs: Notion, _(more coming)_
* Live corrections from users during agent sessions

# How we got here

While building data agents for dozens of companies, from SMBs to enterprises, we learned 2 valuable lessons.

1. Giving agents more context through prompts, skills, or Markdown docs helps them navigate the schema, but the final step is still pretty much “write the SQL from scratch.” Since the entities written to these docs are rigid, the agents still have to decide which joins or definitions to use, how to aggregate, and whether a result is safe to trust.
2. Semantic layers solve the executable part, but they’re extremely painful to build and maintain. Also, a lot of useful context lives outside the semantic layer: dbt, dashboards, query history, warehouse metadata, Notion pages, Slack threads, and corrections from analysts.

ktx combines the best of both worlds: the breadth of a knowledge base + the SQL safety of a semantic layer, optimized for agent use and maintenance.

# Try it out

GitHub: <https://github.com/Kaelio/ktx>

Install manually:

```bash
npm install -g @kaelio/ktx
ktx setup
```

Or tell your agent to do it for you:

```
Run npx skills add Kaelio/ktx --skill ktx and use ktx skill to install and configure ktx
```

If you’d like help managing context for your data agents, book a demo for ktx’s managed version: <https://www.kaelio.com/products/ktx-cloud>

launches.title: Beluga - Creator Marketing on Autopilot
launches.tagline: Run creator marketing like paid ads
launches.body:
**TL;DR**: We run creator marketing end-to-end so companies can test and scale the channel without needing to hire.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107925&key=user_uploads/2204818/717d980b-6271-4c94-a779-1c60e4277af9)

Marketers do not need to be convinced that distribution matters.

The harder question is whether a channel can become repeatable before it consumes the whole team.

Creator marketing is one of those channels. It oftentimes performs 3-5x better than traditional digital ads. When it works, it can drive real awareness, clicks, and signups from audiences that are hard to reach through paid ads. But running it well still tends to mean spreadsheets, inboxes, rate negotiations, contracts, draft reviews, tracking links, payment follow-up, and a lot of manual judgment.

That is what we built Beluga to fix.

---

## Why this problem got under our skin

One of the largest spenders in creator marketing made the labor problem concrete for us. They are spending in the high six figures each month, and told us they employ 30+ people to run their creator partnerships. Even then, each rep can only manage around 18 creators.

They also told us that if they had $2M ready to put into the channel tomorrow, they wouldn’t be able to do it. They would need to hire even more people.

That is a wild ceiling for a marketing channel that should scale with spend.

We got pulled into this from both sides.

Fernando saw the brand side up close at Dare Drop, helping gaming publishers run creator campaigns. The demand was real, but the operating model still looked like a traditional agency: lots of coordination, lots of manual work, and a hard ceiling on how much the team could scale.

We also spent time on the creator side while trying to build a Rippling for the self-employed. Working with creators on taxes showed us the other half of the problem: even when a brand deal is a good fit, the process around it is painful. Creators have to find deals that match their audience and content style, align expectations with the brand, actually run the campaign, and then hope they get paid on time.

We kept seeing the same thing from both sides: brands wanted creator marketing to work, creators wanted better deals and less chaos, and everyone was somehow stuck in spreadsheets, email threads, and manual follow-up.

---

## What Beluga does

The problem is not that creator marketing is mysterious. It works when you find the right creators, give them enough room to make authentic content, track the results properly, and run enough shots on goal.

The hard part is doing all of that consistently without making it a headcount problem.

Beluga is our attempt to make creator marketing feel more like running a paid acquisition channel: set the target, set the budget, see what is happening, and double down on what works.

We run campaigns ed-to-end, including:

* Creator sourcing and vetting
* Pricing and negotiation
* Contracting
* Deliverable management
* Creator payments
* Performance tracking
* Post-campaign analysis

The goal is that a founder or growth team can test creator marketing without building the internal machine. If the results are there, we help them scale the channel without turning it into a hiring plan.

Since starting in March, we have generated over 3M views for clients ranging from YC companies to Series F hyperscalers, and saved over $100k in negotiations.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=107925&key=user_uploads/2204818/2dd9d0b8-f197-41aa-aa36-621c473b6569)

_Beluga helped take Freebuff, Codebuff's free coding agent, from roughly 50 to 1,200 daily active users at peak._

For another Series F company, we drove 3,500+ signups in two weeks.

---

## Who Beluga is for

We are most useful when you already believe creator marketing could fit your market, but you do not want the channel to require a whole internal team before it can scale.

Our bet is that the traditional operating model is the problem: most of the sourcing, negotiation, coordination, payments, and reporting should not require dedicated headcount inside every company.

That also changes what is possible. When the work gets cheaper and easier to coordinate, you can test more creators, go after smaller but better-matched channels, and deploy more capital without being bottlenecked by how many deals an internal team can manually manage.

The signal we look for is simple: can we name a real content audience where your users spend time?

"Developers who watch AI coding tool reviews on YouTube" is a clean audience shape. So is a consumer category with obvious creator communities. A niche B2B buyer can still work, but if the buyer is hard to describe in creator and audience terms, or the product only moves through a long enterprise committee, the test usually has less conversion signal.

The other important thing is seriousness about the experiment. Creator marketing is not one magic post. It takes enough well-matched attempts to learn which creators, formats, and messages work. If distribution is a real priority and you want to test the channel properly, that is the conversation we are best suited for.

---

## Why us

The reason we think we can make this work is that we have lived the messy parts.

Fernando ran millions in ad spend at Meta and then sold creator campaigns at Dare Drop. Zan, our Head of Account Management, led outreach across tens of thousands of creators and is a content creator himself. [@Jack Swisher](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2210281) spent years building AI systems at Bubble and now works on building the infrastructure needed to make our vision a reality.

Between us, we have seen the agency side, the creator side, the paid acquisition side, and the automation side.

Our mission is simple: make creator marketing as measurable and easy to run as paid ads.

---

## The ask

If creator marketing is on your roadmap and you do not want the channel to become an internal ops burden, we would love to chat.

And if you know another founder or growth lead who already believes distribution matters and is thinking about creator marketing this year, an intro would be hugely helpful.

[Learn more here](https://www.trybeluga.ai/)

Hey everyone! We’re [Siddhartha](https://www.linkedin.com/in/siddhartha-javvaji-23b81617a) and [Pratham](https://www.linkedin.com/in/prathamhombal/), co-founders of [Stratify](https://www.trystratify.com) and we’re saving companies millions by helping them understand their users better.

# **TL;DR**

Failing to understand _what_ your users truly want can kill a company. Stratify uses AI agentic workflows to instantly recruit participants, conduct dynamic user interviews, analyze responses, and provide actionable feedback. With simple queries like "What do users think of our new checkout flow?" or “Which prototype resonates most with users?”, Stratify delivers authentic customer feedback within a few hours.

[Stratify Launch Video](https://youtu.be/j0Py7pKyuy4)

---

# **🤦‍♂️ The User Research Problem**

**Here's the brutal truth**: 90% of product failures happen because teams don't truly understand their users. You can’t really blame them because traditional user research **is broken**:

1. **💸 Focus groups are expensive:** $15K+ for 8 people in a room for 2 hours. Half of them drop out last minute, and you're left wondering if these insights represent your actual users.
2. **📅 Manual interviews take weeks:** Booking user interviews feels like herding cats. Calendars stay empty for weeks while your launch deadline approaches. And big ideas _cannot_ wait.
3. **📝 Surveys are unresponsive and impersonal:** Generic forms with dropdown menus can't capture the _why_ behind user behavior. You get some data, but absolutely no story.

**The result?** Teams ship based on assumptions, not insights. Features flop. Users churn. Millions of dollars wasted.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90668&key=user_uploads/2549216/0e975083-d540-4aed-91ac-ea337164777b)

# **✨ Introducing Stratify**

What if you could ask "What do users think of our new product?" and get answers from hundreds of real users in under a few hours? That's exactly what Stratify does.

1. **🚀 Define your Research Questions:**

   Simply describe what you want to learn about your product or upload product materials: _"How do millennials feel about our pricing?"_ Our vetted AI researcher transforms your query into a comprehensive study framework in seconds.
2. **🎯 Smart Participant Matching:**

   Set demographic and behavioral parameters or simply specify a query like "U.S., Gen Z, Online Shopper, Foodie". Our AI automatically finds the perfect participants from our network of millions of real users or directly within your own company’s customers.
3. **🎥 Uncover Real Insights:**

   Watch our AI agents conduct hundreds of interviews simultaneously, asking follow-up questions that dynamically adapt to each participant’s unique responses. Uncover the _why_ behind user behaviors that surveys and focus groups miss completely.
4. **🧠 Instant Analysis:**

   Transform hours of interview content into actionable intelligence instantly. Search conversations semantically, generate reports and slides presentations, or simply chat with your data to find exactly what you need to know.

---

---

* **🚀 Building something new?** Try Stratify before your next feature launch, whether that’s your website, onboarding flow, product prototypes, etc. It could save you months of building the wrong thing—seriously.
* **💬 Know any product managers, product designers, or founders?** They'd love this. User research is their biggest pain point.
* **🙌 Support us** with a follow or share. Every bit helps us reach more teams who are tired of guessing what users want.

---

# **👥 The Team**

[**Siddhartha**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/siddhartha-javvaji-23b81617a) (CEO) and [**Pratham**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/prathamhombal) (CTO) have studied computer science at Stanford, where they’ve conducted AI and high performance compute research at renowned labs. They met in their freshman dorm at Stanford and have been roommates and building together since.

They’ve been in your shoes. They’ve launched features that flopped, ignored user feedback until it was too late, and learned the hard way that assumptions kill products. Now they’re making sure no other team has to learn it the hard way.
