**TL;DR**\
Hotels rarely see what guests wanted before they booked or why they didn't book at all. Anana captures the demand signals buried inside calls, chats, and emails, completing the commercial picture with the intent and friction that transaction data misses.\
\
<https://youtu.be/OxO4FR-M7lI>

## Problem

Hotels are good at measuring outcomes: bookings, revenue, channel mix, and occupancy.

But the signals that explain those outcomes are buried across thousands of guest interactions. A family asks about connecting rooms and books elsewhere. Early check-in questions suddenly double. A repeat guest mentions an anniversary.

At scale, these are commercial signals. They reveal where direct demand is breaking down, what guests repeatedly want, and where hotels can personalize, convert, or win guests back.

Most hotels have no practical way to analyze this information at scale, so the insights disappear and their dependence on third-party distribution continues.

## Solution

Anana turns these signals into a commercial intelligence layer that hotels can analyze alongside booking and operational data.

Commercial teams can see where direct demand is being lost, which guest needs and segments are emerging, and what is driving conversion. Anana then reuses that intelligence across workflows—from improving marketing and the direct booking experience to identifying revenue opportunities and personalizing a guest’s stay.

Every guest interaction becomes an input into the next commercial decision.

## Our ask

We're looking to meet hotel owners, operators, and commercial leaders at multi-property hotel groups—particularly teams responsible for revenue, marketing, distribution, reservations, or commercial strategy.\

launches.tagline: An Intelligent Memory Layer for Real-time Learning
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Theta is building self-learning and real-time adaptation for AI agents.

We’re starting with an intelligent memory layer so agents can remember and learn from previous interactions. With a simple four-line addition to your existing code, our memory layer uses real-time learning to analyze every run for mistakes and optimizations. The relevant insights are then passed on to your agent during future runs. 

We’ve already improved the accuracy of OpenAI Operator by 43% with 7x fewer steps taken. If you’re building AI agents where reliability and speed are priorities, book a meeting [here](https://calendly.com/d/cndj-84h-9qz) or contact us at [founders@thetasoftware.ai](mailto:founders@thetasoftware.ai).

\
https://youtu.be/TRNWfhyUI4E

### **The Current Approach**

Agents struggle to adapt to complex, real-world workflows. Workflows are dynamic, but agents remain static.

* They get stuck in loops, repeating mistakes and requiring constant human guidance in the right direction. Your prompts get longer and longer as you try to hard-code solutions.
* Even when your agent successfully completes a task, this long process starts all over again for any future run. Starting a new Cursor chat or Operator session means losing all of the insights and “aha moments” your agent had.

Learning is fundamentally iterative, but agents can’t learn because they have no memory across runs.

### **How Theta Works**

Theta is building the infrastructure for agents to self-learn and adapt in real-time. The first component is an intelligent memory layer that learns from your agent’s previous runs. Just add four lines of code to your agent stack to get started:

* At the end of the current run, Theta generates and embeds an analysis of your agent’s trajectory. It identifies critical steps and assesses overall performance.
* Before the next run, Theta generates a detailed plan based on the specified task. It gathers relevant insights and optimizations based on previous runs.
* With real-time learning, the memory layer continues to improve with more runs—meaning your agent gets better and better with zero human intervention.

Using this memory layer, we were able to improve the accuracy of OpenAI Operator by 43%. With optimized trajectories, Operator also took 7x fewer steps, resulting in better speed and cost.

### **Our Ask**

If you’re building agents that need to perform dynamic, real-world workflows at the highest accuracy and speed, reach out to [founders@thetasoftware.ai](mailto:founders@thetasoftware.ai) or book some time [here.](https://calendly.com/d/cndj-84h-9qz)

### **Our Team**

Rayan has previously done ML research as Head of Product at DeepSilicon. He’s been childhood friends with Tanmay since third grade, who previously built an AI browser and developed browser agents at MultiOn. During Rayan’s freshman year of college, he met Gurvir, who built distributed ML systems at Cornell, focusing on post-training and RL.

<https://youtu.be/Tp8_JO_IvX4>

## The Problem

Open source models just got really good. DeepSeek was almost a quarter of all traffic on OpenRouter last week.

We spoke to developers building coding agents, personal AI assistants, and code review software, and we asked what the biggest bottleneck was in adopting open source models.

The answer: there is a token shortage. Existing providers either don’t have enough capacity, are too slow, or aren’t reliable enough.

## Meet Prism:

Introducing Prism: lightning fast inference for coding agents. We have three core ideas.

1. Custom deployments for every model

We use agents to optimize our deployments for latency, cost, and throughput. Here’s Deepseek V4.1 Flash running on Prism vs other major providers for the same coding task.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=116844&key=user_uploads/551584/62819c55-2169-4734-927b-8a0a1765e57b)

2. Price tokens like electricity

PG&E charges less for off-peak usage. Token providers should do the same. And not every LLM request is urgent. We can charge less for requests with a wider scheduling window.

3. Enable companies to develop personal intelligence

For domain-specific tasks, teams are adding adapters onto base models. Most providers require them to pay GPU costs, host, and run the model themselves. We offer serverless LoRA inference along with dedicated deployments.

We’ve spoken to

1. teams who are doing more than six figures a month in frontier lab spend
2. teams whose inference providers slow down their products

Hey Everyone! This is Rajit, Land, and Alex

**TL;DR:** Prism is an AI platform for creating short-form videos. Generate assets, build storyboards scene-by-scene, and edit everything in one place.

## **Who Prism is For**

Prism is for anyone who ships short-form regularly:

* **Creators** making memes, skits, explainer videos, ASMR videos, short films, etc.
* **Marketers & agencies** creating paid ads, launch videos, and UGC content

Prism is for anyone who wants to go viral:

* **Founders** aura-farming on LinkedIn with product launches.
* **Consumer/prosumer founders** who spend time on growth-hacking on TikTok when they’d rather be shipping.

## **The Problem**

Creating AI video content today means piecing together a dozen disconnected tools:

* Image generators for concept art
* Upscalers to make them usable
* Image-to-video generators to bring still images to life
* Start/end frame tools for precise scene control
* Lipsync tools to match audio
* Voiceover generators for narration
* Video editors to stitch it all together

Each tool operates separately, so you end up exporting from one and importing into another, then re-describing the same scene to try to keep things consistent. Over time, characters start to vary between clips, the visual style can drift, and the assets get spread across 10 browser tabs and your local drive.

## **Meet Prism:**

Prism is the entire video creation pipeline in one place.

Start with a project, set the style once, and build your story scene-by-scene. Generate images, upscale them, and transform them to animated clips with voiceovers and lipsync all in one platform.

No more exporting between tools or re-prompting every step. Your characters stay consistent, your settings carry over, and your full project context stays attached so every scene looks like it belongs in the same video.

Hey there!  We are [Yi](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yzhong94/) and [Bill](https://www.linkedin.com/in/8illwang/), from [Besimple AI](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/besimple-ai)!  Struggling with data annotation?  Keep reading!

💎 **TLDR**

With Besimple, you can generate your own platform for annotating AI eval and training data instantly.  Simply paste or stream any type of raw data and we'll instantly generate a tailored annotation interface, clear guidelines, an automated human-in-the-loop workflow, and AI judges to scale your insights.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hw-EVKdOhds

## **❌ The Problem**

High-quality, human-reviewed data is essential for improving AI models. But teams today face significant challenges:

* **Complex LLM Workflows**: Most AI startups and even the largest AI companies use spreadsheets for annotations to “move fast”. It is brittle. And it breaks down quickly for dynamic, multimodal, agent-based LLM use cases.
* **Annotation Bottlenecks**: As models get better, only domain experts and someone on your team can improve model performance.  They quickly get overwhelmed when guidelines and data change constantly. This is expensive and slows model iteration.
* **No Feedback Loop**: After a model ships, interesting production data isn’t automatically fed back into evaluation or training, missing opportunities for ongoing improvement.

## **✅ Our Solution:** 

1. Instant custom UI: Just paste or stream your data and we create a custom annotation UI for your task.  We support text, chat, audio, video, LLM traces, and more. 
2. Tailored guidelines: Import any existing guidelines or we will draft new ones aligned with your business goals, ready for annotation
3. AI Judges for real-time evaluation: LLM-based “judges” continuously learn from incoming annotations to evaluate live traffic and flag borderline cases for human review.
4. Enterprise-grade deployment: On-prem optional install, and robust user management for internal SMEs, external vendors, or Besimple’s vetted annotators.
5. Lightning fast setup: No code, no plugins—just drop in your data, set guidelines, and you’re good to go.

**Traction:** The leading AI grading company Edexia uses besimple to annotate hundreds of decisions and improve their evals.

## **The Team**

We’re **Yi Zhong** and **Bill Wang** —who built the annotation platform for Meta’s Llama models. We founded Besimple AI to help everyone spin up a Scale AI in 60s.

AI code generation has dramatically increased the amount of code that is written without the tools for bug finding keeping up, leading to a world with more buggy code that is hindering developers. To improve bug finding, we’ve created an AI agent with the ability to run snippets of your code. We're not just flagging potential issues based on code patterns; we're observing the real behavior of your software. Here’s how it works.

1. When you create a pull request, Jazzberry gets to work.
2. Your repository is cloned into a microVM.
3. Our agent examines the contents of the pull request to guide its search. It can write and execute code in the microVM as it looks for bugs.
4. Jazzberry returns a clear markdown table directly as a comment.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90047&key=user_uploads/2557020/31d75b00-abc3-4a60-8ef5-b3a685edfcd5)

**Real Bugs, Real Impact**

We've already seen Jazzberry make a tangible difference for our early users. So far, Jazzberry has…

* successfully identified a SQL injection vulnerability
* discovered a critical logical error in API key validation
* [found an incorrect page navigation](https://blog.openint.dev/how-we-scale-prs/) (see below, we are formerly known as Prophet)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90047&key=user_uploads/2557020/864328cf-c4b9-4b9a-b267-e9059a158f32)

**Who we are**

We have been friends for over a decade, and are coming together to create Jazzberry. Marco completed his MS at the University of Stellenbosch specializing in LLMs for automated test suite generation. Mateo completed his PhD at the University of Colorado Boulder with a research focus on reinforcement learning and formal methods.

**Our Ask**

* **Try it out** – Jazzberry is available now with a free trial at <https://jazzberry.ai>.
* **Contact us** – We’d love to hear your feedback and what bugs Jazzberry helps you catch. Reach us at [founders@jazzberry.ai](mailto:founders@jazzberry.ai).

launches.title: NODI Energy - Distributed Energy Infrastructure to Rewire the Grid

launches.body:
Hi everyone 👋! We're [Borong](https://uk.linkedin.com/in/boronghu) and [Catherine](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cathjeong/), co-founders of NODI Energy!

**TL; DR:**

NODI is building distributed energy infrastructure to rewire the grid. We are deploying and aggregating batteries at the edge. All these distributed nodes are orchestrated to make the existing rigid grid more flexible, reducing grid congestion and unlocking more capacity at specific constrained locations. So data centers can get **_on-grid_** connection in weeks instead of waiting on grid reinforcement for decades. ⚡ ️ **Gigawatts unlockable on the way!**

Launch video: <https://youtu.be/svScryhDnog>

### **Problem**

The existing power grid was built for the fossil-fuel era, not for tomorrow’s economy. It’s too rigid to deliver power to the right place at the right time.

* 2,000 GW of projects, including data centers, sit stalled in grid connection queues, waiting up to 15 years.
* 200 TWh of renewable energy was curtailed last year, with several countries dumping over 20% of their generation.
* Over 1,000 GW of capacity could potentially be unlocked from the existing network, only if the grid is flexible enough.

### **Solution**

We are building a vertically integrated engine to create a flexible grid. Three layers: 

* **Hardware:** originating from the edge, we deploy our own plug-in batteries and aggregate energy assets from third parties.
* **Software:** orchestrating and operating as these distributed nodes to enable real-time locational flexibility in the grid.
* **Intelligence:** modeling the grid from edge data, reducing grid congestion, and delivering capacity at the right time and place.

### **It’s giving main character energy**🌟

Results in 6 months:

* 2,000 plug-in batteries on the way, per month!
* Onboarding >1 GW of batteries in 2026.
* Secured a pipeline to aggregate 10 GW of assets in 2027.
* Soon to be one of the largest multinational VPPs.

### **Team**

Borong Hu, PhD in power electronics from Warwick and postdoc at Cambridge University, with 60+ papers, IEEE awards, and government grant funding. Built power conversion systems for AI data centers and one of the world's largest offshore wind turbines. Led R&D collaborations with world-leading industrial partners.

Catherine Jeong, Second-time industrial tech founder with a decade of experience across energy, climate investment, and policy. Holds a BA in Political Science from Brown University and an MSc in Climate Innovation from London School of Economics. Former NCAA Division I fencer, now taking a stab at the grid.

* Hiring ambitious talent to join the Power Team.

launches.title: PowerMatrix: Efficient and Compact Power Supply for AI Hardware
launches.tagline: Efficient and compact power supply for GPU and data centers to save 50% energy
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

PowerMatrix delivers highly efficient and compact power supplies for cutting-edge applications—from GPUs and data centers to drones, EVs, and aerospace. Based on proprietary technologies, our power supply systems can reduce energy loss by up to 50%. We’ve built working prototypes and are piloting with world-leading partners.

# **The Problem**

AI computing heavily relies on data centers where every watt of electricity is processed and converted by multiple stages of power supplies—from the power grid to processors.

Currently power supply solutions face significant challenges:

* **Inefficiency:** Data centers consume 5% - 10% of global electricity, while 20% of that (100TWh) is wasted on power supplies.
* **Size Constraints:** Power supply is given very limited space in server trays and on GPU board surface but required to provide much higher power.
* **Performance Gaps:** It is required to provide a voltage conversion ratio over 100 and provide 1A/ns dynamics for robust operation of future advanced AI computing processors.

# Our Solution

Based on proprietary technologies, we provide the reverlutionary **single-stage vertical power delivery solution:**

* **Single Stage:** directly convert high voltage to <1V low voltage, eliminating inefficiencies multiple stage power conversion chains.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90889&key=user_uploads/2116203/943302c9-5ff6-4189-8cd3-47d80cd3b6d0)

* **Vertical Power Delivery:** minimize power transfer loop, locating directly underneath computing chips.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90889&key=user_uploads/2116203/a4ce171d-72bb-4bfe-b640-23d7eb2db1d6)


Results vs. incumbents:

* **80%** smaller form factor
* **50%** less energy wasted
* **10×** faster dynamic response

Deploying our modules can save customers **$10 B** annually, cut **30 TWh** of electricity waste, and avoid **100 Mt** of CO₂ emissions each year.

# Team

We have more than ten years of experience in power electronics and are dedicated to solve the most challenging tasks in this area.

Borong did a Postdoc at the University of Cambridge and got his PhD in power electronics from the University of Warwick. He has extensive experience in research: he published 60 papers that got 650 citations and received the IEEE ECCE William Portnoy Award. He also worked on a power converter for the largest wind turbine at GE, and led a team at Bitmain, a bitcoin miner, to develop a new power supply.

Xufu got his PhD in power electronics from the University of Cambridge. He received the Semikron Danfoss Young Engineer Award in 2025, the Trinity Bradfield Prize Award in 2025, and First Place Award of the IEEE ECCE Best Student Project Demonstration in 2023. He also published 15 papers on power electronics that have 41 citations.

# Our Ask

If you’re building AI hardware, data-center infrastructure, or next-gen power-electronics, let’s connect! [info@pwrmatrix.com](mailto:info@pwrmatrix.com)

**TL;DR:** We are building Cursor for Lawyers. We turn Microsoft Word into an IDE for contracts, and build agents operating in the background. Our initial focus is on Transactional Law Firms, and agents built for quality-assuring projects and documents according to the firm’s best practice.

We have already rolled out Vesence firm-wide at our first enterprise client with a lot of love from both associates and partners.

Know any Transactional Lawyers? Let’s connect: [founders@vesence.com](mailto:founders@vesence.com).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nr1Q7S6A84I

**Problem:**

Imagine programming in Apple Notes.

No linting, no cursor, you are on your own.

That is how it is for many lawyers to draft and review contracts in Microsoft Word.

At law firms, the stakes are extremely high. Every mistake can hurt your reputation badly. Associates need to deliver under time pressure, partners demand extreme attention to detail, and your clients will not accept any blunders.

Given the attention to detail needed in the work, working on complex projects under constant time pressure, we are starting with quality-assuring agents (i.e. a linting system for contracts).

The consequences of shipping "bugs" in a legal document can be catastrophic, but even the best firm still rely on manual review to catch mistakes.

**What We’ve Built**

Vesence offers quality assurance AI agents available straight in Microsoft Word to handle tasks such as:

* **Apply firm-wide Standards**: Apply writing style guides and best practices consistently across all practice groups in the firm
* **Ensure project-level alignment**: Flag inconsistencies across multiple deal documents, for example auto-checking the SPA against the original term sheet
* **Verify document consistency**: Catch defined term slips, bad cross-references, logical gaps, and miscalculations within a single document

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90570&key=user_uploads/2486274/99f83828-eeb2-4d36-9c69-e8401e4ab7b5)

Let’s hear it from our users:

“You saved me 4 hours last night.”

“I’m never sending out a document/project again unless I’ve used Vesence.”

“This is how AI should feel like. Intuitive and extremely helpful.”

**Associates** love Vesence as they can produce exceptional internal deliveries under less pressure to seniors and partners. **Partners** love the tool as their teams hand them better quality work and follows the firm’s best practices.

The interest we have seen from transactional law firms is great, but we also received inbound from other professional service providers that care deeply about quality and the reputation of their firms, including Investment Banks and Management Consultants.

Basically, the holy trinity of where the ‘pls fix’ culture thrives.

# TL;DR

Third Chair is building agents for in-house legal teams. We’ve started in media/entertainment, where our agents can identify IP infringements, collect evidence, and help recover millions of dollars in damages at scale. 

# 🛑 Problem

In-house legal teams are constantly underwater with a million tasks on their desk. Many of these are **repetitive**, **manual**, and **mind-numbing**: 

* Our customer at a music distributor spent hours tracking down brand contacts, then weeks following up with different emails just to reach the right department.
* Our customer at a major record label spent weeks reviewing thousands of social media ads and manually logging results in a spreadsheet.
* Our customer at a music publisher spent a majority of his time on email follow-ups for unpaid invoices, unsigned contracts, and unanswered emails.
* Our customer at a music rights investment firm didn’t have time to draft individual demand letters for thousands of infringements they wanted to pursue.

When you're buried in a million tasks, it can be hard to prioritize what matters most to your business's bottom line. At worst, you can miss opportunities that could turn the legal department from a cost center into a **profit driver**.

# ✅ Solution

That’s why we’re building Third Chair for in-house legal teams, starting in media/entertainment. Our customers delegate end-to-end workflows to Third Chair so they can operate at scale: 

* Our browser agent detects uses of your copyrights, trademarks, or name-image-likeness across the web.
* Our outreach agent finds the right business contact, verifies deliverability, and sends follow-ups.
* Our contracts agent drafts demand letters for human review, incorporating the context gathered in previous steps.

**TL;DR**

Klavis AI provides [open source](https://github.com/Klavis-AI/klavis) MCP integration for AI applications. Integrate enterprise-grade MCP servers with your AI application in a minute, and scale to millions of users using our open-source, hosted MCP servers with multi-tenancy auth, and skip MCP client-side development hassle.

**Ask:** Can you introduce us to companies working on AI agents and applications that need different external integrations? Contact us at [xiangkaiz@klavis.ai](mailto:xiangkaiz@klavis.ai).

Launch video: https://youtu.be/HFn5xWC6cAk

**The Problem**

* **Missing Native Authentication & User-based Authentication:** Lack of built-in and user-based authentications in MCP servers creates security risks and adds development complexity, hindering production use.
* **Lack of Enterprise-Grade Servers:** Available MCP servers are frequently underdeveloped personal projects, lacking stability, features, and remote capabilities essential for enterprise environments.
* **Client-Side Connection Barrier**: Accessing MCP servers requires developing the clients, creating technical overhead and hindering adoption, especially for existing function calling infrastructures that lack native MCP support.

**The Solution**

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcq7Lridm_hh7ACd4DFh6Zcsc38dMU3Kp8X9MdK55P_JuQVQ-ZMA6Pc75Qs7C0wc3vDdjlMOVmTCHNVZ-5MUpNbrLibGrFzzcARZme9csIpjPP5yENtddc01TW1newc1A1pGFepKw?key=HpOTxrRvVOxut3yp-iTaNhMb)

Klavis AI solves these problems by:

* **Secure, Enterprise-Grade Hosted Servers:** Launch stable, enterprise-grade MCP servers instantly via API. Our hosted solution includes built-in OAuth & multi-tenancy auth, eliminating security gaps and complexity.
* **Skip Client Development Hassle:** Use our API to connect any remote MCP servers from your existing backend, or let users interact immediately through our pre-built Web, Slack, and Discord clients.
* **Trust Through Open Source:** Our MCP servers and clients are open source, ensuring transparency and fostering community trust.

**Concrete Example**

Imagine you want your AI agent to interact with your company's Jira. Instead of building a custom Jira integration and wrestling with authentication, use Klavis AI. With simple API calls, you instantly get a secure, hosted Jira MCP server ready to go. It handles OAuth and user-level authentications automatically, letting your AI securely query tickets right away – no MCP client coding required.

**Why Us**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90202&key=user_uploads/259581/6621b1de-ea41-46f4-bc9e-97b0676a7c97)

Xiangkai previously worked as a Senior Software Engineer on the Google Gemini at Google Deepmind. His work involves building the function calling infrastructure for Gemini and supporting multiple Gemini agentic feature launches. The challenges in the MCP space resonate strongly with his background, and he's very excited to bring his insights and energy to accelerate innovation here.

Zihao previously worked on Lyft’s Rider team and Nordstrom’s analytical data platform team, with expertise in scaling systems for millions of users and NLP background from University and Master studies.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90162&key=user_uploads/1091672/94e086c6-918d-4975-94ca-5aece8bff85a)

Hey, I'm Win, founder of [ParaQuery](http://www.paraquery.com).

# **The Problem**

Data is the new oil and you're feeding your products with a bunch of it. But to do so, you need to build, maintain, and optimize your data infra. That's either a huge timesink, or you're bleeding cash to ignore it, or someone is breathing down your neck about this month's cloud bill. Why can't we just ship features?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90162&key=user_uploads/1091672/419acb3d-1195-4842-a80e-df02ac0d332f)

Whether it's those 20-minute+ Presto queries, or your exploding BigQuery bill (which happens to be tracked in real time), your data infra is letting you down.

# **Our Solution**

ParaQuery runs on highly-parallel, throughput-optimized cloud-available hardware, perfect for data processing workloads: **GPUs**!

Our system abstracts out the infra required to serverlessly accelerate your logic. With the extreme efficiency of GPUs, it's half the cost and double the performance of competing solutions like Databricks and BigQuery, without any platform commitments.

For SQL-based data warehouses like BigQuery, you can use ParaQuery with minimal changes to your queries. And since it's fully Spark-compatible, there's no vendor lock-in. It integrates with literally anything which has a Spark connector, on any major cloud. We can even deploy on GPU clouds.

ParaQuery makes data processing as simple as specifying:

1. Inputs
2. Output
3. Logic
4. Run!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90162&key=user_uploads/1091672/a6cded39-2da7-432b-9129-014a593caaae)

# **Why?**

I've been looking into GPUs and parallel programming for over 12 years – starting out with crypto. I left that field pretty fast, but I never stopped thinking about efficient compute and GPU acceleration. Even more so when, years later, I had to wait for my laptop to finish 18-hour physics simulations. And during my professional career, I've also had to wait on my fair share of 20-minute+ analytical queries.

**The Problem:**

AI progress demands more chips, more power, and more data centers—a **trajectory that is physically and environmentally unsustainable** with purely classical infrastructure.

**The Solution:**

Augment classical infrastructure with quantum processors built for AI, since quantum can provide exponential speedups for specific AI tasks. **Sygaldry is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to speed up training and inference and creating tools for AI researchers to integrate quantum capabilities into AI models and workflows.**

**The Impact:**

* Reduce the time between model releases
* Fine-tune existing models faster
* Enable faster token generation for distributed LLMs
* Unlock faster inference for diffusion models
* Conduct greater exploration in novel model architecture
* Leverage secure quantum communication channels
* Increase AI affordability, accessibility, and personalization

**Sygaldry’s Unique Approach:**

Most quantum computers are built using one type of quantum bit, but each qubit has distinct strengths and weaknesses. **Sygaldry AI servers combine multiple qubit types within a single, fault-tolerant architecture to leverage their strengths, while avoiding their limitations.** This is the same way classical computers are made. We believe this approach to quantum will seem obvious in retrospect.

Hello!

We are [Hans](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kumarhans) and [Hardik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hardiksingh) - longtime friends and co-founders of Boost Robotics.

**TL;DR**

Boost Robotics builds autonomous mobile manipulation robots that can inspect and physically interact with data center infrastructure.

Instead of dispatching technicians for every cable check, reboot, or hardware swap, data centers can now triage and resolve issues through “robot remote hands”. When not performing interventions, the robots continuously provide 24/7 security monitoring and operational analytics.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SVqbUd1crU0

🚨 **The Problem**

As AI infrastructure continues to scale up, data center physical operations are becoming increasingly difficult:

* **Growth bottleneck:** AI demand is scaling faster than the operational capacity to support it.
* **Increasingly Remote Locations:** Data centers are being built near cheaper power sources in sparsely populated areas—often with limited access to skilled labor.
* **Competition:** Hyperscalers are looking for every possible edge. Downtime means SLA violations and lost revenue.
* **Hazardous Environments:** Maintenance involves high-voltage power and toxic liquid coolants.

Now more than ever, robots are gaining the dexterity and generality to solve these critical problems.

🤖 **The Solution**

We are building a general purpose robot to handle a variety of use cases in data centers. 

* Predict, find, and solve issues faster, even when you’re not physically on-site. 
* Enable one skilled technician to debug multiple issues across multiple sites through context-aware teleoperation, and eventually autonomy.
* Provide 24/7 security monitoring and inventory management, simplifying compliance and financial audits while collecting data for your data center digital twin models.

launches.tagline: Turn parts and task requirements into working machine designs in minutes, not years.
launches.body:
We’re Ayna and Andrew, and we’re building [MorphoAI](https://morpho.ai/). We’re a team of manufacturing tech experts and MIT PhDs who have written 30+ papers on foundational research of AI design methods for robotics engineering. We met at Harvard last year and decided to help people develop hardware at the speed of software. 

In our research, we demonstrated capabilities that allowed engineers to generate 100s of verified optimal designs from parts and task requirements in minutes, and now we’re translating those findings to a product for robotics & automation. We’re cutting R&D cycles by 50 %+ and letting teams ship better hardware, faster!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iGmXIsoUc2Y&feature=youtu.be

### **Problem**

Designing a new robot, machine, or work‑cell still feels like 1985: weeks of manual CAD drawing, long prototype‑and‑test loops, and “does it even work?” uncertainty. A single product can take 40‑100 iterations and burn through months of engineering time. This all amounts to $240B spent on mechanical design each year. https://www.morpho.ai/ 

### **Our Take**

What if you could take requirements and ideas into _validated machine designs_ automatically? We’re building that for hardware—so engineers can explore more, better-performing designs, fine-tune the ones likely to work, and land on an optimal design before the first part is cut. Engineers input and tasks and constraints (_what the robot must do)_ and their favorite parts to build with, and MorphoAI’s software auto‑generates, verifies, and fine tunes manufacturable designs in minutes—cutting R&D cycles by 50 %+ and letting teams ship new hardware faster. 

### **The MorphoAI Platform**

1. **Generate** hundreds of verified design candidates from parts and task requirements in minutes, and select the concepts to fine-tune.
2. **Simulate** full‑dynamical behavior with optimal, verified controllers.
3. **Optimize** for cost, performance, weight, manufacturability, and more.

The result is a ready‑to‑manufacture machine design, programmable motions, and BOM—delivered in minutes, not months.

### **Team**

* **Ayna Arora** (CEO, Co-founder) – Harvard Business School; Former VC, 2x founder in manufacturing tech setting up factories across the world.
* **Andy Spielberg, PhD** (CTO, Co-founder) – MIT CSAIL; Harvard PostDoc (digital manufacturing). 30+ papers on Optimization algorithms in robotics design.
* Founding team: Allan Zhao (MIT PhD on GenAI for robot design), Amira Abdel-Rahman (Havard + MIT PhD on design for hardware) Han Wang (simulation expert in research+industry).

We’re also backed by ARIA (UK Government’s Invention Agency) with a 2.5MM GBP Grant.

### **What’s Possible Today**

Our early users are:

* Resizing robot geometry and motors to maximize reach and payloads.
* Redesigning workcells to minimize costs, design time, and improve margins.
* Auto-generating new end-of-arm tooling designs from parts in hours, not weeks

### **Big Picture**

MorphoAI is the “compiler” for the physical world. As we expand our capabilities, any company will be able to invent machines that were previously infeasible— shrinking $MM R&D budgets and accelerating everything from factory automation to medical innovation to planetary exploration.

### **Let’s Talk**

Building a new robot or a new cutting-edge machine? We’d love to talk. Drop us a note at [**hello@morpho.ai**](mailto:hello@morpho.ai) .

launches.body:
# Scalar Field: The agentic trading desk

Hi all,

We’re Aman and Ramakant, founders of Scalar Field.

I previously worked as a trader at Tower Research and Goldman Sachs. Ramakant led engineering teams at Microsoft. We’ve both spent our careers at the intersection of finance and technology, and we’re now building the infrastructure financial agents need to operate in markets.

**TL;DR:** Scalar Field lets you turn an investment idea into research, a backtest, and a live trading agent in one place. Agents can use LLMs for research and reasoning, then run strategies through an event-driven execution layer with approximately **300 ms event-to-trade latency**.

<https://youtu.be/Uhd-RtQ1XjM>

## The problem

Over the next few years, agents will not just help people research markets. They will actively participate in them.

They will monitor news, parse filings, analyze data, test hypotheses, manage portfolios, and execute trades.

But today’s financial infrastructure was not built for this.

Market data is fragmented across providers. Research and backtesting happen in separate systems. Execution requires another set of integrations. Most financial platforms are dashboards designed for humans, not infrastructure designed for agents.

There is also a more fundamental problem: most AI-agent frameworks assume every action should begin with an LLM call.

An event occurs. The agent sends context to a model. The model reasons about it, chooses a tool, and eventually places a trade.

That is often the wrong modality for trading agents.

LLM calls are costly and introduce significant latency. A trading agent cannot call a language model every time a price changes, a signal fires, or a portfolio needs to be rebalanced.

LLMs are useful for interpreting unstructured information, researching ideas, and developing strategies. They should not have to sit in the critical path of every trade.

## What Scalar Field does

Scalar Field separates the agent’s reasoning layer from its execution layer.

Agents can use LLMs where intelligence and interpretation are valuable. They can then convert those decisions into deterministic, event-driven strategies that continuously monitor markets and execute without another LLM call at every step.

Scalar Field handles:

* Financial data and research compute
* Python-based strategy development and backtesting
* Event and schedule-based strategy triggers
* Persistent agent state
* Portfolio allocation and position tracking
* Risk and execution checks
* Order routing and reconciliation
* Real-time performance and NAV tracking

This lets users go from thesis to backtest to live portfolio without stitching together data providers, compute infrastructure, agent frameworks, and brokerage APIs.

## Where agents can trade

Scalar Field currently supports:

* **Robinhood** — US equities and ETFs
* [**Public.com**](http://Public.com) — US equities and options
* **Polymarket** — prediction markets
* **Jupiter DEX** — Solana tokens and tokenized assets
* **Alpaca** — US equities and options

We also support paper trading through Alpaca and Polymarket, so users can test agents before allocating real capital.

**Hyperliquid support for crypto perpetual futures and spot is coming soon.**

## What you can build

For example, you could build an agent that:

* Tracks which public companies are increasing AI capital expenditure, then continuously rebalances into the companies investing most aggressively in data centres, chips, and AI infrastructure.
* Monitors insider purchases across thousands of companies, tests whether purchases by CEOs or directors predict future returns, and automatically trades only when the historical signal is strong enough.
* Reacts to market-moving events such as earnings surprises, inflation data, interest-rate decisions, breaking news, or sudden changes in prediction-market probabilities.
* Watches every live sports game and trades when the market overreacts, for example, when the team that started as the favourite falls behind early but its estimated win probability begins to recover.
* Runs a simple deterministic rule, such as buying a stock when a predefined signal crosses a threshold, without making an LLM call at all.
* Or goes much deeper: trains a transformer on historical market data, uses the model to generate signals in real time, and automatically executes trades when those signals meet the strategy’s risk and confidence requirements.

Our long-term vision is **agentic portfolios**: portfolios created, managed, and continuously rebalanced by agents around any thesis, narrative, event, or market signal.

We believe agents will become some of the largest participants in financial markets. But that will not happen by simply connecting a generic LLM-agent framework to a brokerage API.

Trading agents need infrastructure that combines intelligence with financial data, event-driven compute, persistent state, portfolio management, risk controls, and low-latency execution.

That is what we’re building with Scalar Field.

## Asks

1. **Try Scalar Field** and tell us what breaks, what is missing, and what trading agent you would build first.
2. **Introduce us to quantitative traders, developers, and investment teams** experimenting with AI-driven research, portfolio management, or automated execution.

You can try it at [**scalarfield.io**](http://scalarfield.io).

Hey YC! I’m [Aman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amandeep-singh0/) (ex-trader from Tower Research and Goldman Sachs), building **Scalar Field** with my co-founder [Ramakant](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ramakant-yadav1/) (ex-Microsoft).

### **The Problem We're Solving**

Why does anyone log in to a trading terminal like Bloomberg or FactSet?

Because — whether consciously or subconsciously — there’s a **hypothesis in their mind**. Something they're trying to validate as they jump across **charts, news, fundamentals, and macros**.

But here’s the issue: **Terminals today are built like giant dashboards**.\
What traders and analysts actually want is to **test and validate ideas**, not just observe data. So we asked ourselves — why not **rebuild the terminal from scratch** to do exactly that?

---

### **What We’re Building**

At **Scalar Field**, we’re reimagining the trading terminal from the ground up using **intelligent agents**. We started with retail traders as a way to build credibility with institutions—and already have around 800 paying traders, over 34,000 signups, and **$74,000** in monthly revenue.

Our goal is simple:\
**Let users test any market hypothesis instantly — and intelligently.**

We’re building a terminal that can:

→ **Run compute-heavy backtests** across multiple datasets (fundamentals, prices, macro, alternative data)\
→ **Spin up agents** that reorganize dashboards based on new signals or events\
→ **React to live market changes** and even **initiate trades** when conditions match your criteria\
→ **Persist memory across sessions** — so your research trail is never lost\
→ **Chain multi-hop workflows:** e.g., _If ETF flows spike and earnings surprises drop, highlight affected sectors and show next trade ideas_

It’s not just data access — it’s **agent-driven insight and action**.

launches.tagline: AI agents that fully automate specialist referrals
launches.body:
Primary care providers make over 100 million referrals to specialists every year, leading to tens of millions of hours in manual coordination work. We built AI agents to automate the entire specialist referral process for primary care groups.

[**https://youtu.be/LqlDMjHARl0**](https://youtu.be/LqlDMjHARl0**)

## **Problem**

Managing specialist referrals is one of the most time-consuming workflows in primary care. Staff must manually copy data between systems, complete prior authorizations, call specialists to verify information and request medical records, and coordinate with patients.

Many clinics are forced to hire or outsource their referrals, but they’re still understaffed. As a result, referrals often never get sent, are returned for missing authorizations, or go to out-of-network providers. Nonetheless, poor referral management has significant consequences:

* In value-based care models, specialist routing has a massive impact on medical spending. Out-of-network costs and unnecessary procedures are major cost drivers.
* Groups that depend on federal funding or grants, like FQHCs, can lose funding due to poor referral follow-through.
* Patients who experience delays in care because of referrals are likely to churn and find a new primary care provider.

## **Product**

We partnered with a network of rural health clinics in west Texas to understand the specialist referral process. We started by manually handling referrals, then built AI agents to automate the whole workflow. Our agents are live across the network, where we’ve:

* Sped up referral processing time by 82%
* Found available appointment times that were 55% sooner
* Led to 44% fewer referral kickbacks

## **Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95206&key=user_uploads/1184840/3e4114e5-24ec-4c32-af9c-37c3848f300c)

Tanishq Kancharla has worked in startups throughout his career. He was a product engineer at Shortwave, leading development on their iOS and Desktop apps, used by tens of thousands of people. Prior to this he double majored in physics and computer science at Carnegie Mellon.

Michael Kronovet was technical lead overseeing Palantir's work with the US State Department, quadrupling annual revenue without increasing headcount. Previously, he built causal inference models at a healthcare startup. He graduated in 3 years from Carnegie Mellon with a BS in statistics and machine learning.

launches.tagline: Manufacturing pharmaceutical drugs faster and in the USA
launches.body:
We manufacture pharmaceutical drugs faster than current methods and in the USA. We are building microfactories that can handle the upcoming wave of AI-designed drugs and safeguard against biothreats.

[Launch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W_lJOs7k7nI)

### **The Problem**

America is at risk of ceding leadership in advanced biomanufacturing to China.

* **Drug manufacturing is moving to China;** 79% of US biotech and pharma companies already have at least one contract with a Chinese firm, _primarily because they are faster._
* **China is investing billions in biotech**; one third of new compounds licensed by US pharma are now _discovered and manufactured_ in China, up from almost none five years ago.
* **Over-reliance on foreign biomanufacturing is a national-security risk;** agile, on-shore manufacturing is critical to protect our nation against future biothreats.

### **Our Solution**

A contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for advanced drugs, rebuilt from the ground up to address the future of America’s biomanufacturing needs.

* **Faster biomanufacturing**; Our platform leverages advanced methods to accelerate production timelines and de-risk scale-up.
* **Modular container factories**; our form factor is a standard shipping container that can be brought up to operation in roughly two weeks and shipped where it is needed.
* **Supply-chain independence;** by vertically integrating and manufacturing critical equipment in-house, we secure production against global disruptions.

### **Why It Matters**

* **Drugs can be developed faster**; shorter production cycles move life-saving drugs from the lab to the clinic up to a year sooner.
* **More drugs can be developed**; we will be able to manufacture the thousands of low-volume, personalized biologics that will be designed by AI.
* **Strengthening US autonomy;** rapid-deploy, U.S.-based capacity protects the nation from supply shocks, geopolitical turbulence, and potential bioweapons.

### **Who We Are**

We love biomanufacturing. Together, we built Protein Evolution, an industrial biotech company that turned plastic waste into new textile fibers. Scott is ex-McKinsey and a Yale mathematician (he loves a good cost model almost as much as he loves America). Mike earned his PhD in Bioengineering from Penn after completing Penn’s M&T program in undergrad (he builds DNA, software, and bioreactors).

* AI that thinks like a human assistant, not a search algorithm

**The Problem and Solution:**

Trucking has always been a mission critical industry, with nearly 70% of all US goods hauled via trucks, resulting in a need for continuous operations. This results in an industry that hasn’t paused for a tech update in years; in my time in the industry, I saw dozens of offices running on pen and paper or excel spreadsheets, documents being sent in WhatsApp group chats connected to printers, and I myself had 3 phones all on hold menus with different people. And even the largest of companies today navigate a maze of outdated, poorly integrated point-solutions.

So, alongside Anthony and Sam, I decided to build a product that rectifies those problems. With Hemut’s software, you can replace pen and paper scribbles with intuitive oversight of even national level fleets, replace the WhatsApp group chats and manual data entry with AI document parsing, and eliminate the need for 3 phones with AI agents to automate inbound/outbound calls. With Hemut, trucking companies can execute every step of the trucking workflow—from finding and booking a shipment, driver communication, and logging every last dollar—all on one platform, with efficiency never seen before.

**The Story:**

At 16 years old, I got kicked out of my home and faced homelessness, working 100-hour weeks at a motel where I met a truck driver who I eventually helped file paperwork for. Siezing the opportunity, I also helped file paperwork for his friends too, eventually saving enough money to start dispatching trucks and put a roof over my head.

Fast forward 6 years to the end of 2024, I realized that voice AI would eventually be capable enough to automate a lot of the bottlenecks I encountered during my time in the logistics industry.

chrt is a logistics platform for time-critical shipping. We enable businesses to deliver their most critical items same-day.

Time-Critical Logistics is a $30B market growing at a 20% CAGR driven by growth in American healthcare and manufacturing.

Businesses that place time-critical orders are enterprises who have urgent items they need to deliver ASAP. These orders are critical in nature and often require white glove service -- think therapeutic treatments for healthcare providers or specialized equipment for manufacturers. 

chrt builds the software for forwarders and professional couriers who pick up and deliver these orders. Couriers use chrt to coordinate and track their shipments, including a driver app and fleet management tools. Forwarders use chrt to dispatch couriers, book flights, and track time-critical orders from start to finish. Shippers use chrt to place these orders with their providers and to monitor everything. 

In addition, we also sell physical tracking devices that can be used to track valuable cargo or assets.

This gives us full control of the shipment and allows us to provide shippers with end-to-end tracking. It also allows us to intervene early if we notice something is going wrong.

We’re software engineers that became friends years ago at McKinsey. Kyle is an expert in Time-Critical Logistics, having led strategy at a leader in the space. Aaron is an expert at designing and implementing AI systems to handle complex coordination. We were shipping code together on nights and weekends for years before chrt; now we’re also shipping freight.

Security is fundamentally broken for most engineering teams today:

* **Scanners are unreliable** - They flood engineers with 30-50% false positives, wasting precious development time
* **Traditional pen testing is too slow** - It happens quarterly at best, costs a fortune, and takes weeks to complete
* **AI-accelerated development creates new risks** - Teams are shipping code faster than ever, but security reviews have become an even bigger bottleneck

The result? Companies are forced to choose between shipping fast or shipping secure. Engineering teams lose **\~20%** of their time dealing with security issues or slowing down to accommodate outdated security practices.

## 🚀 Our Solution

[MindFort.ai](http://MindFort.ai)'s autonomous security agents work 24/7/365 to find, validate, and patch vulnerabilities:

* **Find** complex vulnerabilities like a human tester would
* **Validate** every finding to eliminate false positives
* **Patch** with intelligent fixes that integrate directly with your codebase
* **Scale** to thousands of tests in an instant, giving coverage never possible before

Unlike solutions that slow development, MindFort accelerates it by eliminating security bottlenecks. Our platform is already finding vulnerabilities in production systems that other tools miss, identifying issues in bug bounty programs, and scoring high on human penetration testing benchmarks.

## 💡 Our Story

Brandon worked as a PM at ProjectDiscovery, a security scanner company where he led development of the Nuclei cloud platform from an open source tool to an enterprise ready product. He then joined NetSPI, one of the world’s largest penetration testing firms, to build generative AI tools for human testers. He sat with countless customers across both companies, learning about their struggles in securing attack surfaces at scale.

Akul received his masters in computer science from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, and was drawn to AI and security early on in his academic career. He co-authored multiple papers on using LLMs to perform various cybersecurity attacks, worked on creating novel benchmarks for hacking agents, and participated in red teaming and model safety programs at both OpenAI and Anthropic.

Sam worked as a senior engineer at Salesforce, where he led security for a large business unit, Tableau. During his time there, he worked first hand on keeping a large scale product secure. Between juggling security assessments, validating findings, and managing remediations inside of a large organization, he had seen it all. He began experimenting with ways to use AI to help solve some of the issues he faced at Salesforce and even worked on a demo of a tool to perform agentic code review through a DARPA program. He recently completed a master’s degree in cybersecurity at UC Berkeley.

We all met through our work and research. Early on, we all realized that the future of security was going to belong to AI agents, and that the coming tidal wave of new code generated with AI would need a solution of equal magnitude.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90555&key=user_uploads/525065/51cbc28d-9ff7-41b3-af19-d3e9fc23ef0a)

## 🔮 Our Vision

Security should accelerate your business, not slow it down. We're creating a world where security testing happens continuously and vulnerabilities are patched autonomously, **keeping your product and your users safe, while letting you ship faster.**

launches.body:
Hi! We’re [Dmitry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dmitrykarpov/), [Sergey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yudovskiy/), and [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/odinalex/) — co-founders of [Adentris](https://www.adentris.com/).

**TL;DR:**

Every year, **250 million insurance claims — worth billions of dollars — are denied due to documentation errors**. Many are never recovered. We connect directly to hospital EHRs, monitor clinical staff activity logs in real time, and use AI agents to detect and fix compliance issues before they become risks. **Since the beginning of YC, we’ve reached $54k ARR** and have a growing number of commercial pilots with hospitals and clinics across the U.S. and PoCs with healthcare enterprises.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PrcEY8WgmSk

**Problem:**

One small documentation mistake — like recording a medication time incorrectly — can destroy a family’s finances.

These errors are often made by exhausted clinicians after 12-hour shifts and are caught by automated insurance systems that instantly deny the claim.

**Hospitals don’t discover the problem until it's too late** — after the claim is denied, the audit triggered, or the reputation damaged.

Documentation errors are the invisible threat in modern healthcare. They’re not caused by negligence, but by broken systems: cluttered interfaces, overworked staff, and legacy EHRs that make it easy to click the wrong time, forget a discharge note, or miss a required signature.

**And it’s not just claims** — these small errors lead to failed audits, regulatory fines, delayed discharges, and increased burnout.

Hospitals end up with compliance teams that are reactive — chasing mistakes days or weeks after they happened, often without resolution. The cost isn’t just money. It’s morale, trust, and patient safety.

**Solution:**

Adentris is an AI compliance autopilot that prevents small documentation errors from becoming costly disasters in real time.

We integrate directly with hospital EHRs, monitor clinical activity in real time, and use AI agents to detect and fix issues — like missed discharge notes or wrong medication times — before they trigger claim denials or audits.

When a problem is found, our AI opens a quick conversation with the responsible staff member to confirm and correct it immediately.

**We don’t just alert**. We resolve — and help hospitals run smoother, reduce pressure on teams, and recover revenue that would otherwise be lost.

**What Experts Are Saying:**

"Adentris’s proactive approach is a game‑changer in reducing preventable errors and enabling real‑time accountability in care delivery.”

— [Joel N.H. Stern, PhD](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joel-n-h-stern-07a4342/)\
Professor of Neurology & Molecular Medicine, Zucker School of Medicine at Hofstra/Northwell

**Team:**

[Dmitry](https://www.linkedin.com/in/dmitrykarpov/) (CEO) and [Sergey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yudovskiy/) (CPO) are second-time YC founders with a strong track record in building B2B enterprise products and go-to-market channels. Sergey comes from a full medical family and has deep personal ties to the problems we're solving in healthcare. [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/odinalex/), (CTO), is a seasoned engineer who built apps used by 25M+ people worldwide and led the development of a full AI agent architecture at his previous multimillion-dollar startup.

**Asks:**

We're actively looking to connect with:

* **Hospital executives and clinic owners** who want to stop losing revenue to preventable compliance errors and team burnout 
* **Providers' CFOs and compliance leaders** who are tired of fighting with clinical staff over documentation and want a system that just works
* **Medical institution advisors and operators** who care about transforming broken workflows
* **Reporters and storytellers** covering the untold side of healthcare — the back office chaos that leads to financial disaster

If you're building, reporting on, or fighting to fix this problem — DM us, email us at [founders@wrkdn.com](mailto:founders@wrkdn.com), or grab 15 minutes with us here [Book a call](https://calendly.com/d/cnpv-x29-nzc/workdone-demo).

Let’s save healthcare from the inside out.

launches.tagline: AI agents that capture the risk, close the gaps, and make the calls, so small teams can keep whole populations healthy.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋 We’re Lalit and Catherine, co-founders of Pelica Health.

## **TL;DR**

Pelica is the AI operating system for value-based care. We pull claims, EHR, pharmacy, lab, and hospital feeds into **one canonical record**, then run AI copilots that read and write to it: risk adjustment, Stars and quality, pharmacy, provider network, and care management, plus an AI data analyst you can ask anything in plain English. The copilots **do the operational work themselves**: capturing HCCs in real time, closing gaps once across every payer, and making outreach calls in the member’s language. HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II, and RADV-defensible.

We’re live with a physician-led IPA in New York, one of the largest independent medical groups in the Northeast: **2,500+ hours saved** and higher CMS Star Ratings so far.

▶️ Watch their story: <https://youtu.be/2CGmyif9Yd4>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/e873acc4-f206-4eca-8617-9bf7f70f3b62)

_An AI agent works one gap end to end: provider office, pharmacy, the member in their language, the payer portal, then a live call. Closed in 3 minutes of staff time._

## **🚩 The problem**

Value-based care pays a medical group or health plan to keep a whole population healthy, and billions in CMS bonuses ride on it. The teams who own those contracts decide whether the org makes money, and they cannot operate:

• Their data lives in 8 to 15 systems. By the time a problem surfaces, the submission window has closed.

• Risk calls a member. Quality calls the same member. The practice calls again, sometimes in a language the member doesn’t speak.

• The best predictive model is worthless if it never reaches the provider.

• The rules keep moving. Hybrid HEDIS is retiring into ECDS volumes many times higher per measure, and the V28 phase-in costs the average MA plan about 3% of RAF.

Every new gap gets a new point vendor, each with its own portal, data model, and login. These teams do not need another point tool. They need an operating system.

## **🛠️ What we built**

One canonical record, with an AI workforce next to every team. Six copilots:

• **Risk Adjustment:** real-time HCC capture with trumping logic and RADV-defensible chain of custody on every code.

• **Quality and Stars:** gap closure unified across every payer, with year-round forecasting for the post-hybrid HEDIS world.

• **Pharmacy and Part D:** PDC lift on the three triple-weighted measures that move Stars the most.

• **Provider Network:** auto-built practice agendas that cut meeting prep from 90 minutes to 15.

• **Care Management:** ADT-driven transitions-of-care worklists, with no duplicate calls across teams.

• **AI Data Analyst:** plain-English questions against the record, in place of the BI ticket queue.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/13a2d9aa-5ac8-4ab4-bf2c-b61fe8bccb56)

_Risk Adjustment: the agent works the EHR and payer portals like a person and captures a defensible HCC._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/cfb57b8c-bf75-43d1-9dc3-d29da891d8e9)

_AI Data Analyst: ask your RAF in plain English, get an answer and a chart in seconds._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103962&key=user_uploads/1494518/4bbf9afb-abc0-4221-9e5b-bf4602654e32)

_Provider Network: reps walk in prepped, and the visit is captured into tasks automatically._

It runs on the systems VBC teams already use: Epic, Cerner, Athena, eCW, payer SFTP, PBM feeds, ADT, and labs, with SMART-on-FHIR overlays in Epic and Athena. A new source onboards in days, and the copilots start working the day after.

## **📈 Early proof**

That physician-led IPA went from three uncoordinated calls per member to one outreach, in the right language, that closed three gaps at once. No new headcount. One of their leaders put it simply: “You don’t just get software, you get partners.”

## **👫 Why us**

Catherine and I met at YouTube and have built large-scale systems together since. We saw the same gap from two sides: clinical AI that could not operate, and operations software that could not reason clinically.

• **Catherine** led AI work on Gemini and enterprise agents at Google, did clinical AI research at Stanford School of Medicine, and saw front-line care at clinics in California and New Hampshire. BA in Computer Science from Dartmouth.

• **Lalit** spent 8 years building software for regulated industries at Google and YouTube, most recently as engineering and ML lead on YouTube Payments, running a 45-person team on products driving $16B+ in revenue. Wharton MBA, ACM-ICPC World Finalist.

Backed by Y Combinator, SurgePoint Capital, Upside Partnership, ISEED Ventures, and Progressive Ventures.

## **🙏 Our ask**

• Warm intros to VPs of Risk Adjustment, Stars, Quality, or Pharmacy at MA plans, IPAs, MSOs, or ACOs.

• Intros to ACO executive directors running MSSP or REACH.

• If you run risk-bearing contracts at a health plan, IPA, MSO, ACO, or medical group, email [lalit@pelica.com](mailto:lalit@pelica.com) or book a demo at cal.com/pelica/pelica.

Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7475922350316732416/) and [X](https://x.com/cthrnzh/status/2070159740295160294), and learn more at [pelica.com](http://pelica.com).

## 🚩 The Problem

VBC teams own the contracts that decide whether the org makes money. They cannot operate. Today:

* Data lives in 12 places. By the time a problem surfaces, the submission window has closed.
* Risk calls a member. Quality calls the same member. The practice calls again. Sometimes in a language the member doesn't speak.
* The best predictive model is useless if it never reaches the provider.
* Hybrid HEDIS is retiring. ECDS volumes run 35 to 75 times higher per measure. The old infra was not built for it.
* V28 phase-in finishes in 2026. The average MA plan loses roughly 3% of RAF.

Point vendors keep stacking up. One for retrospective coding. One for HEDIS. One for adherence. One for ADT. Each with its own portal, its own data model, its own login.

VBC teams need more than another point tool. They need an operating system.

## 🛠️ Our Solution

We built Pelica, an AI operating system for value-based care. Three layers, six copilots, one canonical record.

* **🌐 HIPAA + SOC 2 Type II:** Tenant-isolated, encrypted end-to-end, zero-retention with every LLM provider in use.
* **🔌 Connects to every system:** Epic, Cerner, Athena, eCW, payer SFTP, PBM feeds, ADT, labs. SMART-on-FHIR overlays in Epic and Athena.
* **⚡ Live in weeks, not quarters:** A new data source onboards in days. Copilots start working the day after.

What Pelica can do:

* **🧾 Risk Adjustment Copilot:** Real-time HCC capture with trumping logic, MAO-004 awareness, and RADV-defensible chain-of-custody on every code.
* **⭐ Quality & Stars Copilot:** Unified gap closure across every payer, with year-round glide-path forecasting for the post-hybrid HEDIS world.
* **💊 Pharmacy & Part D Copilot:** PDC lift on the three triple-weighted measures. The 5 points that separate 4-star from 2-star.
* **🤝 Provider Network Copilot:** Auto-generated practice agendas. Meeting prep from 90 minutes to 15.
* **🏥 Care Management Copilot:** ADT-driven TOC worklists, 5-day follow-up tracking, no duplicate calls across teams.
* **📊 AI Data Analyst:** Plain-English questions against the canonical record. Replaces the BI ticket queue.

A Director of Risk Adjustment told us: "**Our data lives in twelve places. By the time we know there's a problem, the submission window has closed**." A Stars Program Manager told us: "We are solving the same problem five times." Same root cause. One shared record fixes both.

## 👫 The Team

Catherine and Lalit met at YouTube and have been building large-scale systems together ever since. They saw the same gap from two sides: clinical AI that could not operate, and operations AI that could not reason clinically.

**Catherine led AI work on Gemini and enterprise AI agents at Google**. She did clinical AI research at Stanford School of Medicine and saw front-line patient care at clinics in California and New Hampshire. BA in Computer Science from Dartmouth.

**Lalit spent 8 years building software for regulated industries at Google and YouTube**. He was Engineering and ML lead on YouTube Payments, running a 45-plus person team in Commerce Billing on products driving $16B+ in revenue. Wharton MBA. ACM-ICPC World Finalist.

Backed by Y Combinator, SurgePoint Capital, Upside Partnership, ISEED Ventures, and Progressive Ventures.

launches.title: Vision Lab: The Industrial Data Layer for Robotics
launches.tagline: Aggregating the Largest Manufacturing Process Data for Robotics Training
launches.body:
## **TL;DR**

We capture and structure real factory workflows at scale, pairing first-person industrial video with SOP-level process knowledge, so robotics and AI labs can train models on the data that actually exists inside production environments, not just lab demos. We are already working with 2 frontier AI labs.

🎥 **Our 60-second Product Launch**:\
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u2CyfEnYY5A>

## **THE PROBLEM**

The robotics industry is being trained mostly on lab demos, even though robots will ultimately need to operate in messy, high-variance real factories. The industry has **less than 0.3% of the data it needs**, and almost none of it comes from real factory environments.

Why?

**Industrial data does not exist at scale**\
It cannot be scraped or passively collected. It has to be captured inside real factories, on real production lines, during real operations.

**Raw footage is not enough**\
Unstructured industrial video is noise. Models need process context: what step is happening, in what order, with what tools, and whether it was done correctly.

**Crowdsourcing cannot solve it**\
Understanding industrial actions requires factory expertise. Anyone can label an object; far fewer can distinguish whether a torque check, weld, inspection, or setup sequence was performed correctly.

---

## **THE SOLUTION**

Vision Lab solves the industrial data problem by building:

**The most diverse industrial dataset**\
SOP-structured production data spanning cutting-edge environments like biotech, EV manufacturing, semiconductors, and medical devices, as well as large-scale manufacturing.

**Industrial access at scale**\
A network of **2,000+ factories across 50+ industries in 27 countries**, with operators and factory owners embedded in the capture process so every sequence, tool, and technique is recorded correctly at the source.

**A proprietary VLM for industrial settings**\
A temporal VLM trained on SOP-paired industrial footage to understand not just what is happening, but the **order, timing, and correctness** of real industrial processes. Our state-of-the-art VLM outperforms Gemini by **2.5x on temporal understanding in industrial settings**.

---

## **PARTNER WITH US**

If you believe the next decade of robotics and world models will depend on **real-world industrial data, not just compute**, we’d love to talk.

Vision Lab partners with robotics labs, frontier AI teams, and manufacturers to build the default industrial data layer for robotics.

**Contact:** [founders@thevisionlab.ai](mailto:founders@thevisionlab.ai)\
**More info**: [www.thevisionlab.ai](http://www.thevisionlab.ai)

### **TL;DR**

LineWise is building an AI assistant for manufacturing teams to get their production lines back up and running - fast.

We connect siloed factory data (PLCs, maintenance logs, manuals) to triage faults, guide technicians to fixes, and capture every resolution for smarter troubleshooting in the future.

🎥 **Our 60-second Product Launch:\
[https://youtu.be/DfnmQ4k8q-k](https://youtu.be/DfnmQ4k8q-k)**

### **THE PROBLEM**

When a line goes down, it can take **hours** to identify the problem. Engineers and technicians chase PLC logs, flip through outdated manuals, and rely on the one person who “just knows.” While production stalls, tribal knowledge disappears, and the same issues repeat.

### **THE SOLUTION**

LineWise centralizes critical knowledge by integrating siloed data from IoT sensors, maintenance records, and machine manuals. It ranks the most likely causes and guides the team to a fix in just **minutes**. But the best part? It remembers every issue for next time and advocates for preventative actions.

---

### **How LineWise Works**

🔧 Upload an error code image or describe the issue in a message.

🤖 The AI provides a refocused problem statement for confirmation.

📊 The AI dynamically ranks possible hypotheses of causes by probability.

🧠 A human validates each hypothesis to identify the true cause.

🛠️ Resolve the issue by following a step-by-step guide.

🔍 Conduct further investigation to uncover the root cause.

📚 Enrich the knowledge base with insights from the issue and resolution.

---

### **Join Us to Revolutionize Manufacturing**

LineWise partners with forward-thinking manufacturers to minimize unplanned downtime, empower frontline teams, and unlock the value of siloed data within a company. 

If that sounds like you, we’d love to talk.

Founded by entrepreneurs, the mission is simple: to help home service businesses succeed and thrive, no matter their size. Cactus brings clarity, automation, and peace of mind to busy teams, removing daily bottlenecks so owners can focus on growth.

From first call to booked job, Cactus delivers consistent, reliable experiences so businesses can win more work and build stronger customer relationships.

launches.title: StarSling Runners - Self-Driving CI
launches.tagline: Fast GitHub Actions runners with AI agents that continuously improve your CI to make it up to 6x faster and 13x cheaper.
launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We're Yonas & Daniel, co-founders of [StarSling](https://www.starsling.dev).

**TL;DR: [StarSling Runners](https://starsling.dev/)** are an AI-native drop-in replacement for ubuntu-latest that continuously make your CI up to **6x faster** and **13x cheaper**. On day one, StarSling Runners are faster and cheaper. From there, AI agents analyze your pipelines and continuously ship optimization PRs.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IxcYY5cuSXA>

**🤔 Why now**

Coding agents made writing code dramatically faster, and they’ve pushed PR volume up, which compounds CI times and cost fast.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104233&key=user_uploads/7866/2149565f-569b-4f8d-b4b3-9eab341daf0f)

Everyone has the option of getting fast CI runners now. What nobody has is **CI that adapts and improves itself**.

Meanwhile, keeping a CI pipeline fast is a constant manual chore: caches break, tests get flaky, build steps pile up, and someone has to notice and fix it, over and over. We believe DevOps tooling like CI should be as agentic as coding is, and that's the unlock behind self-driving CI: the optimization work that used to be a recurring human task now runs continuously in the background as part of the infrastructure running it.

**🔥 The problem**

Keeping CI fast is nobody's job and everybody's problem:

* **Pipelines rot.** Caches get misconfigured, dependency installs get slow, tests turn flaky, build steps stop being parallel. Performance quietly degrades until someone carves out time to fix it.
* **Fast runners alone don't solve it.** Swapping in faster hardware helps once, then your setup drifts right back as you add more code and tests and they get more complex. Plenty of products give you faster runners. None of them keep your pipeline optimized for you.
* **It's getting worse.** Recent GitHub Actions pricing changes hit teams running lots of jobs, and GitHub's focus has clearly moved elsewhere. When we surveyed companies looking for DevOps AI solutions, a GitHub Actions agent was the single most-requested solution engineers wanted.

**🧯 The solution: self-driving CI**

StarSling Runners are an AI-native, drop-in replacement for ubuntu-latest\
that get faster the longer you use them:

* **Fast infrastructure on day one.** 5th Gen AMD EPYC (\~30% faster than GitHub), actions/cache compatible with zero config, unlimited concurrency.
* **AI agents that optimize your CI for you.** Agents continuously scan your workflows, jobs, run logs, and machine telemetry, then open optimization PRs: fixing caching, speeding up dependency installs, parallelizing build steps, sharding tests, and restructuring workflows. This is the part nobody else does. Real PRs our agents opened and customers merged: [sharding E2E tests across 3 parallel jobs](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/15888) (Mastra), [optimizing Playwright browser installs](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/8073) and [fixing turbo cache config](https://github.com/better-auth/better-auth/pull/7950) (Better Auth).
* **Cheaper, with no surprises.** $0.008/min vs GitHub's $0.012/min (33% cheaper), queue time never billed, no seat fees.
* **You stay in control.** Every agent-authored optimization ships as a PR your team reviews and merges.
* **Secure by default.** Every job runs in its own single-use, hardware-isolated microVM that's destroyed after the run, the same isolation model GitHub-hosted runners use. Secrets pass directly from GitHub to your job and are never stored by StarSling.
* **One-line install.** Install the [StarSling GitHub App](https://github.com/apps/starslingdev) and copy our AI install prompt to swap ubuntu-latest\
  for starsling-ubuntu-24.04. You're on faster runners immediately, with 2,000 free minutes your first month. The optimization agents are in early access right now, so request access and we'll turn them on for your repos. **👇**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104233&key=user_uploads/7866/a91c193f-d5e1-4d00-a93c-1dfd6381666b)

**📈 Traction**

After being in private beta for the past four months, StarSling has now run over **one million CI jobs** for fast-moving teams like Better Auth, Mastra, Partcl, and more, and the self-driving AI agents is what won them over:

* [**Mastra**](https://starsling.dev/customers/mastra) got **6x faster** CI:
  * _"The runners are just handled, so nobody on my team thinks about CI infrastructure anymore, and the agents keep optimizing for the one thing I care about: minutes saved."_ - Abhi Aiyer, Co-founder & CTO at Mastra (YC W25)
* [**Better Auth**](https://starsling.dev/customers/better-auth) got **2x faster** E2E:
  * _"StarSling agents are like a CI engineer we never had to hire. They find the slow spots, test out fixes, find the ones that work and open the PRs themselves."_ - Bereket Engida, Founder & CEO at Better Auth (P25)
* [**Partcl**](https://starsling.dev/customers/partcl) got **13x cheaper** CI, and the agents proved themselves on day one:
  * _"Within a day of migrating to StarSling Runners, their agents opened up a PR that literally made our Rust CI tests 2x faster!"_ - Vamshi Balanaga, Co-founder & CTO at Partcl (YC P25)

Full case studies: <https://starsling.dev/customers>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=104233&key=user_uploads/7866/10826f60-8e4d-41a8-a800-32026a78bfc8)


**🏋️ Team**

**Daniel** led the 12-person engineering team at Netflix that built their Internal Developer Portal ("Netflix Console"), the central hub for Netflix's 3,000+ engineers and the highest-DAU internal developer tool at the company. Before Netflix he was on Facebook's AI Camera team, building computer vision that powers camera effects for 100M+ DAUs across Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp.

**Yonas** built StackShare, one of the largest online developer communities (1.5M+ registered developers), with an enterprise offering used by Fortune 500s to surface tech stack data across thousands of internal codebases. StackShare was acquired by FOSSA in 2024.

We've spent our careers on developer tools, and self-driving CI is the first part of a suite of tools we always wished we had.

**🔮 Vision**

DevOps should be as agentic as coding. CI is just the start. We're building toward a world where your entire pipeline improves on its own and AI agents take on the slow, manual engineering work that’s left after your coding agents finish, across the whole SDLC, so your team ships faster.

**👇 Our ask**

* **Try it.** If your team runs CI on ubuntu-latest, you're a one line change away from faster runs: <https://starsling.dev>. YC companies get 50% off the first year.
* **Intros.** If you know a CTO or VP Eng at a company drowning in CI time or cost, we'd love an intro: 📧 [founders@starsling.dev](mailto:founders@starsling.dev)

Happy Slinging!

\- Yonas & Daniel
